title: Principal Product Manager
description:
The role: 

  

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the end-to-end success of Curri’s SaaS business, with Route Planner as the current flagship product. This role operates as the business owner for SaaS — defining product vision, driving adoption, and translating customer needs into a roadmap that grows usage, retention, and revenue over the next 12–24 [months.This](http://months.This) is a build-and-scale role, not a maintenance role. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Sales, Operations, and Customer Success to turn Curri’s operational expertise into scalable, revenue-generating software products that directly shape Curri’s long-term SaaS strategy.
  
**What you will do:**   
- Define and own the long-term product vision and growth strategy for Curri’s Route Planner and broader SaaS offerings.
- Act as the business owner for SaaS, prioritizing investments based on customer impact, revenue potential, and strategic value.
- Anticipate enterprise customer needs and translate workflows into intuitive, high-impact product solutions.
- Partner closely with Engineering to ship software quickly and iteratively, balancing speed with quality.
- Collaborate with Sales, Operations, and Customer Success to ensure products are effectively positioned, adopted, and expanded.
- Lead customer discovery and validation efforts to de-risk new SaaS product ideas.
- Prepare and present clear updates on product strategy, progress, and outcomes to executive leadership.
  
**What you need to have:**   
- 7+ years of experience in software product management with demonstrated success scaling a SaaS product from 0–1 or 0–10.
- Strong bias toward action with a proven ability to partner closely with engineering teams to deliver iteratively.
-  Exceptional stakeholder management skills and the ability to drive clarity across competing priorities.
- Ability to clearly communicate complex initiatives and inspire teams around a shared product vision.
- Strategic, big-picture mindset with hands-on execution skills.
  
**Bonus Points:**   
- Experience building or scaling logistics or operations-focused SaaS products.
- Former founder or early-stage operator experience.
- Background working directly with enterprise customers.
  
**What’s in it for you:**   
- You’ll have the opportunity to own and shape Curri’s SaaS strategy from the ground up, with meaningful responsibility and direct exposure to executive leadership.
- This is a high-impact role where your decisions will directly influence Curri’s growth, product direction, and long-term business model.
- We offer a competitive salary, equity, comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision, 401k), and a flexible work environment with a strong respect for work-life balance.
  

Who are we? 

  

We are Curri and our mission is to be the way the world delivers construction and industrial supplies. Curri provides on-demand, last-mile logistics for construction and adjacent industries with our nationwide fleet of cars, trucks, and flatbeds. 

  

Curri was founded in 2018 and was a part of the YC S19 Batch. Employees work out of our office in Ventura, CA, but the majority of our fast-growing start-up operates remotely, with over 100 employees spread across the United States. 

  

We're solving a massive, global problem of inefficiency in the construction industry through innovative technology and AI-driven solutions. We imagine a world of efficient construction sites resulting in a net win for the entire world. Find out more at [curri.com](http://curri.com).

title: Product Manager - Clinical Pathways & Analytics
description:
At AgileMD, we are building the most advanced real-time predictive analytics and clinical decision support platform for hospitals. Our cloud-based engine helps hundreds of thousands of doctors and nurses across the country make faster, more informed medical decisions — so that every patient receives the highest quality and value of care based on the latest medical knowledge and data. We are proud to make a meaningful impact on patient outcomes every day.

AgileMD's products integrate with the electronic medical records systems of large hospital networks and deliver highly available, robust clinical tools. These tools ingest, transform, and analyze large amounts of patient data in real-time, making complex risk assessments and predictions across a distributed infrastructure built to the strictest security and regulatory standards. Our product portfolio includes eCART, our FDA-regulated early warning and clinical decision support platform, Pathways, our clinical pathway builder used by leading health systems, and a growing suite of custom clinical applications.

We're looking for a Product Manager who is energized by execution, thrives on getting things across the finish line, and knows how to build deep relationships with customers. This is a role for someone who loves the operational side of product work — turning well-defined initiatives into shipped features, coordinating across teams, managing rollouts, and becoming the company's institutional expert on customer needs. You'll work directly alongside our Head of Product, who drives strategy and rapid product definition, and your job will be to own the delivery layer and make sure great ideas become great outcomes.

---

## Requirements — You will:

In the first 6–12 months, you'll:

* Own execution of defined product initiatives end-to-end — from project kickoff through delivery and rollout — keeping engineering unblocked and timelines on track
* Manage inbound enhancement requests, bug reports, and feature feedback across customers and internal stakeholders via Jira Help Desk and internal channels, building a structured intake and prioritization workflow
* Drive the product side of alpha, beta, and production rollouts — coordinating with implementation and CS teams on timing, feature flagging, training materials, release notes, and customer-facing communications
* Conduct customer interviews and build structured knowledge of clinical workflows and user needs, feeding insights back to product strategy
* Take high-fidelity prototypes and product specs through to polished, implementation-ready designs in collaboration with engineering
* Support FDA documentation workflows for eCART within the regulatory framework set by clinical and regulatory leadership, ensuring documentation stays current and audit-ready
* Maintain project tracking, status communication, and cross-functional coordination across engineering, clinical, sales, and customer success — working within existing team structures across eCART, Pathways, and Custom Apps

---

## Requirements — Who you are:

* You have 5+ years of product management, product operations, or technical program management experience — and a proven track record of getting things built
* You're an execution-oriented PM who derives satisfaction from launching things reliably, not just defining them
* You have a strong eye for design and can take rough prototypes to polished, implementation-ready specs
* You're comfortable leading customer conversations, running discovery interviews, and organizing feedback into structured insights
* You communicate exceptionally well — in writing and in person — with engineering, clinical stakeholders, and customers
* You're energized working in a fast-moving environment where AI is changing how product work gets done
* Experience in health tech, clinical software, or EHR-adjacent products is strongly preferred
* Familiarity with FDA regulatory documentation workflows is a plus
* You thrive as part of a lean team and don't need to own the strategy to be motivated — you're excited to execute with autonomy and build something that matters

title: DevRel
description:
### Build With Developers. Not Just For Them.

At Anakin, we’ve built an early-stage API product designed for speed, experimentation, and real developer feedback.

We’re looking for a **DevRel** who lives on the internet - someone who understands developer conversations, builds communities naturally, and knows how to turn feedback into product momentum.

This is not a passive content role. It’s high-ownership, high-visibility, and deeply impact-driven.

### What You’ll Focus On (First 3–6 Months)

* Reduce onboarding friction (docs, examples, clarity)
* Identify and deeply support the first serious API users
* Increase meaningful developer sign-ups
* Build structured feedback loops into engineering
* Refine messaging through real developer conversations

\~80% of this role is external-facing, engaging developers globally (US-facing exposure preferred).

### What You’ll Do

* Improve API documentation and onboarding flows
* Engage developers across HN, Reddit, Discord, Twitter/X, etc.
* Separate curiosity from real usage
* Collect and synthesize actionable product feedback
* Help debug integrations and close the loop once fixes ship
* Create lightweight technical content (guides, demos, walkthroughs)

### What We’re Looking For

* \~1 year of DevRel / API-facing experience (flexible for high-impact profiles)
* Prior DevRel preferred, or strong proof of building in public (community, writing, open-source)
* Strong communication + comfort with APIs and integrations
* Ability to turn developer conversations into product insights
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing products

If you care more about real adoption than surface-level community numbers, this role is for you.

### Candidate FAQs – Developer Relations

**Question: What do we do at Anakin?**

Answer: At Anakin, we turn the internet into a reliable data source for software. We provide developer tools that let you access any web data, including websites, apps, and documents, through a clean API. Our platform handles all the hard parts, such as scraping behind logins, rate limits, proxies, and JavaScript heavy pages, so you get structured, reliable data without spending weeks building and maintaining pipelines. Essentially, we make the outside world programmable for developers and companies of any size.

**Question: Who are the founders?**

Answer:

* Mohit Prateek (IIT Bombay)
* Rashmi Bala (IIT Kanpur)

**Question: What about funding & revenue?**

Answer: We’ve raised USD 1.8M in seed funding, are currently at USD 3.25M in revenue, and are profitable.

**Question: What is the headcount?**

Answer: As of Feb 2026, we are 60+ team members.

**Question: What is the base location? Is it remote, hybrid, or in-office?**

Answer: The role is based out of HSR Layout, Bangalore. We work from the office Monday to Friday.

### Role-Specific FAQs

**Question: What does DevRel mean at Anakin?**

Answer: DevRel here is not about events or vanity community metrics. It’s about:

* Improving developer onboarding experience
* Supporting serious API users
* Building tight feedback loops into engineering
* Driving meaningful adoption

\~80% of the role is external-facing.

**Question: What will success look like in the first 3–6 months?**

Answer:

* Reduced onboarding friction (docs, examples, clarity)
* First serious API users identified and supported
* Increase in meaningful developer sign-ups
* Structured product feedback influencing roadmap

**Question: Is this a content-heavy role?**

Answer: Content is part of it, but not the core. The focus is on real conversations, debugging support, and improving developer experience. Lightweight technical content supports this.

**Question: Is prior DevRel experience mandatory?**

Answer: Preferred, yes. If not formally in DevRel, you should demonstrate strong community-building or “building in public” experience (open-source, Twitter/X, Discord, writing, etc.).

**Question: How technical does this role need to be?**

Answer: You should be comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, debugging issues, and developer workflows. You don’t need to be a senior backend engineer, but you must be technically credible.

**Question: What kind of developer audience are we targeting?**

Answer: Primarily global developers, with preference for US-facing exposure. Strong communication skills for international audiences are important.

**Question: What is the hiring process?**

Answer: Typically 2–3 structured rounds, including:

* Community/product thinking assessment
* Technical & DevRel depth discussion
* Final round with leadership

We maintain a strong hiring bar - only high conviction candidates move forward.

title: Founding Senior Product Manager
description:
## **ABOUT RETELL AI**

Retell AI is using the first principles to reimagine the call center with cutting edge voice AI.

Since launching 18 months ago, thousands of companies now utilize Retell’s AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors, we have scaled to $36M ARR with a team of 20 people, up from $5M at the start of 2025.

Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we’re creating intelligent AI “workers” that can act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers — continuously executing, monitoring, and improving customer interactions.

We’re growing quickly and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move fast, and have real impact at one of the fastest-growing voice AI startups.

Let’s build the future together.

- We’re a top 50 AI app in a16z list: [https://tinyurl.com/5853dt2x](https://tinyurl.com/5853dt2x)

- #4 on Brex's Fast-Growing Software Vendors of 2025: [https://www.brex.com/journal/brex-benchmark-december-2025](https://www.brex.com/journal/brex-benchmark-december-2025)

- We're also one of the top ranking startups on: [https://leanaileaderboard.com/](https://leanaileaderboard.com/)

**<u>Take our product for a spin</u>**

We wanted to give you a glimpse into what we do. We created a fun AI recruiter that provides general information about our company and details on each open role.

You can reach **Victoria** at **+1 (415) 704-7048**. Have fun with it—ask about us, our growth, our roles, or anything else you’re curious about.

## **ABOUT THE ROLE**

As our **Founding**  **Senior Product Manager** , you’ll take end-to-end ownership of core product areas that power millions of AI-driven conversations. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, and customers to define the roadmap, drive execution, and ensure we’re shipping products that are fast, reliable, intuitive — and worthy of becoming the industry standard.

This role is highly technical with a wide scope and a direct impact on our customers. You’ll work across real-time audio, telephony workflows, agent behavior, and developer tools—all to build products that enable thousands of businesses to deliver faster, more reliable, and more human customer experiences every day.

## **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

- **Own customer outcomes** for core product areas such as voice agent behavior, onboarding, testing, and AI-driven automation. Define strategy, roadmap, and success metrics based on real customer pain, adoption, and business impact.

- **Develop deep customer understanding** by spending time with users, reviewing call transcripts, joining onboarding and support sessions, and directly engaging with customers to uncover unmet needs and failure points.

- **Author clear, outcome-driven PRDs** that define the customer problem, requirements, end-to-end user journey, and proposed solution concepts. Use these documents to align engineering, design, and stakeholders with scope, tradeoffs, and success criteria before execution.

- **Incorporate competitive and market insights** into product strategy and prioritization, ensuring clear differentiation and informed tradeoffs.

- **Partner closely with engineering to design scalable solutions** , while continuously evaluating tradeoffs through the lens of customer value, time to impact, and long-term platform health.

- **Work cross-functionally with Sales, CX, and Customer Success** to understand buying signals, objections, rollout blockers, and expansion drivers, and reflect those insights in product priorities.

- **Partner closely with design** to shape end-to-end user experiences, including early problem framing and low-fidelity sketches to explore and align on solutions before execution.

- **Drive cross-functional execution** by planning, sequencing, and tracking product initiatives to ensure timely delivery, clear ownership, and alignment across engineering, design, and stakeholders.

- **Validate solutions with customers early and often** , using prototypes, betas, and rapid iterations to ensure we are solving the right problems before scaling investments.

- **Establish product rituals that keep the organization customer-focused** , including roadmap planning grounded in customer evidence, prioritization frameworks tied to impact, and clear communication of tradeoffs and decisions.

## **YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF**

- **5+ years of product management experience** , ideally building B2B, product-led growth (PLG) products.

- **Comfortable in high-velocity startup environments** and energized by ambiguity, fast iteration, and ownership.

- **Customer-obsessed** — you regularly talk to users, review real usage (e.g. calls, sessions, workflows), and turn feedback into action.

- **Strong cross-functional collaborator** , working closely with engineering, design, sales, and other partners to drive outcomes.

- **Founder-level ownership and bias toward action** , taking responsibility for outcomes end to end and driving work forward with urgency and accountability.

- **Highly organized and execution-oriented** , able to create clarity, prioritize effectively, and keep things moving in messy, evolving spaces.

- **Experience working on AI products is a plus** , with **voice AI experience a strong advantage** ; you’re curious, adaptable, and eager to go deep technically.

## **JOB DETAILS**

- **Cash:** $200,000 – $290,000

- **Equity:** Offer Competitive Equity

- **Location:** San Carlos, CA (Redwood City, CA)

- **US Visas:** Retell AI is open to sponsoring work authorization for qualified candidates, including H-1B, TN, L-1, E-3, F-1 (OPT/CPT), and O-1 visas.

## **OTHER BENEFITS**

- 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance

- $70/day DoorDash credit for unlimited breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks

- $200/month wellness reimbursement

- $300/month commuter reimbursement

- $75/month phone bill reimbursement

- $50/month internet reimbursement

## **COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY**

- **Best Offer Upfront:** Choose from three cash-equity balance options; no negotiation needed.

- **Top 1% Talent:** Above-market pay (top 5 percentile) to attract exceptional builders.

- **High Ownership:** Small teams, \>$1M revenue/employee, and significant equity.

- **Performance-Based:** Offers tied to interview performance, not experience or past salaries.

## **INTERVIEW PROCESS**

1. **Recruiter Screen** – **15 min -** Initial conversation to align on background, experience, and role expectations.

2. **Hiring Manager Intro** – **30 min -** Deep dive into your experience, problem-solving approach, and how you’d work with the team.

3. **Conversation with our CMO or CTO** – **30 min-** Speak with our CMO and CTO to help us better understand your approach to product development.

4. **Onsite –**  **Final Round -** Focused on a deep product walkthrough, cross-functional collaboration discussions, and a final conversation with the founders.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
$150K - $200K // 0.50% - 1.00% // San Francisco

# Role

As our first and only product manager, you’ll work alongside our founder to drive the evolution of Anara and shape how researchers work with AI. You’ll build novel tools that will transform how scientific discoveries are made for decades to come.

As model intelligence accelerates, the ultimate form factor of agents for scientific research remains unwritten. We’re looking for a product manager who combines deep technical understanding, genuine love for science, and strong product intuition. You should be equally comfortable discussing customer feedback with world-class researchers, debugging user workflows with engineers, and presenting product strategy to the team.

### **Your work might include:**

- Performing discovery through user interviews, session replay, data analysis, etc. and present findings to the team.

- Translating cutting-edge AI advances into practical features for researchers.

- Surfacing trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices.

- Optimizing existing flows to reduce friction, lower churn and increase conversion.

- Working closely with the engineering team to ensure Anara remains the best way to do scientific research with AI.

### **You’re likely a good fit if:**

- You are quick, scrappy and first and foremost a builder. Product at Anara moves lightning fast. We typically take features from idea to production in days, not weeks or months.

- Have a combined 2+ years in product management and engineering, including at least 1 year as a professional engineer.

- You have world-class design and product taste.

- Have independently built and scaled a product to at least a few thousand users (e.g. a side project or open-source project).

- Have worked in a high-growth, fast-paced environment (ideally another startup) and can drive things forward with relatively little oversight.

# Anara

Our goal is to achieve 100 years of scientific progress in the next 10 years. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for industry researchers and graduate students, using a combination of inventive research, design and engineering.

In two years, we’ve grown to millions of users across the world’s most ambitious academic labs and R&D teams, we are fast approaching $10M in yearly revenue, and we raised $3M from Y Combinator and the founders of GitHub and Reddit.

We're a small, tight-knit team of 10 people with huge ambitions. As a founding member, you'll be instrumental in helping us scale revenue from $10M to $100M and then $100M to $1B+.

If you’re excited by the idea of being a part of that, definitely apply.

This is an in-person opportunity in San Francisco.

We’re more than happy to sponsor visas. If we make you an offer, we'll work with an immigration attorney to make sure everything goes smoothly.

We offer premium healthcare (medical, dental, etc.), flexible working hours and office space with a beautiful view of the San Francisco marina and Golden Gate bridge.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Our mission

The trucking and logistics industry provides the backbone of the economy. But the payments infrastructure on which it runs is broken. For the hard-working men and women of this sector, the existing suite of payment tools is outdated, difficult to use, prone to fraud, and saddled with shady fee structures. The incumbent players in this space often overlook the economic and practical needs of this user base.

**We're changing that.** [<u>AtoB</u>](https://atob.com/) is building Stripe for Transportation — modernizing the payments infrastructure for trucking and logistics. Supply chains rely on the timely movement of capital to function efficiently. Our end game is a world in which that capital movement occurs fairly, smoothly, and without delay. As we pursue that end game, we aim to center our customers in every way — offering them world-class customer experience and building products that work with and around the unique constraints of their daily lives. We build for fleet managers in the office and drivers on the road. We strive for products that are efficient, satisfying, and useful. **Our customers enable our modern economy —** _ **they deserve it** _ **.**

Our history and background

Our founding team has backgrounds in payments, working on autonomous vehicles at Cruise Automation, leading ops and growth for Uber, and building apps that were featured on the Apple app store. We have staff and senior engineers from Google, Uber, Meta, Shopify, Stripe, Chime, and other leading technology companies.

We have raised $125 million+ from investors such as General Catalyst, Elad Gil, Bloomberg Beta, Y Combinator, XYZ; founders and CEOs of companies such as Google (Eric Schmidt), Salesforce (Marc Benioff), Coinbase (Brian Armstrong), DoorDash (Tony Xu), Instacart, Gusto; strategic investors like Mastercard, Flexport and Samsara.

We were named to Forbes annual [<u>Next Billion-Dollar Startup List</u>](https://www.forbes.com/sites/amyfeldman/2022/08/16/next-billion-dollar-startups-2022/?sh=4899e6d55308), and have just recently been selected to join the[<u>World Economic Forum</u>](https://www.linkedin.com/company/world-economic-forum/) as a Global Innovator.

## **About the role**

As a Senior Product Manager at AtoB, you'll own a core surface of product end-to-end — shaping the strategy, leading a cross-functional pod, and shipping products that change how a multi-hundred-billion-dollar industry handles money.

You won't be a feature factory. You'll be expected to develop a sharp point of view on where we should bet next, defend it with evidence, and then drive a team to execute. You'll spend real time with truckers, dispatchers, fleet managers, freight brokers, and factoring partners — because the best product instincts in this market come from people who've actually sat in a truck stop.

This is a high-ownership role with broad scope. You'll help set the bar for how a product gets built here.

## **What you'll do**

- **Develop a deep point of view** on AtoB's competitive position and where we should invest next — grounded in direct conversations with customers and ecosystem partners (freight brokers, factoring companies, fuel networks).

- **Own the strategy and roadmap** for your area, including success metrics, sequencing, and the trade-offs that come with both.

- **Lead a cross-functional pod** of engineers, designers, BizOps, and partners across Sales, Partnerships, and Support — from discovery through launch and iteration.

- **Run user research** with fleet managers and drivers, including in-the-field visits. Ground every decision in real customer pain, not internal opinion.

- **Use GenAI tooling (Claude Code and similar)** to prototype quickly and align the org behind a shared vision _before_ committing engineering resources. We expect PMs here to operate hands-on with these tools — not just direct others to use them.

- **Partner with design** to ship UX that works for users with widely varying levels of technical fluency, on devices ranging from desktops in dispatch offices to phones on the road.

- **Use data to drive prioritization** , measure impact, and make the case for what to build next.

## **What we're looking for**

**Must-haves**

- 5+ years of product management experience, ideally including B2B or enterprise software

- A track record of operating across the full product arc — vision and strategy through detailed execution and GTM

- Strong customer research instincts; comfortable running discovery sessions with non-technical users in person and remotely

- Hands-on experience using GenAI tools to prototype, communicate, and accelerate your own work

- Strong written and verbal communication; able to influence engineers, designers, executives, and external partners with differing technical backgrounds

- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams through ambiguous, complex product launches

- Comfort working with data (SQL or equivalent) to investigate questions and back up decisions

**Nice to have**

- Background in transportation, trucking, logistics, fuel cards, or fleet payments

- Experience at an early- or mid-stage startup

- Experience building for field-based, blue-collar, or otherwise underserved end users

title: Product Manager
description:
Arketa is building the operating system for modern fitness and wellness. Our mission is to make wellness more accessible by empowering studios and wellness entrepreneurs to grow beyond in-person classes. We provide a powerful, all-in-one platform to manage and scale hybrid wellness businesses—whether online, in-person, or both.

With Arketa, users can easily manage schedules, accept bookings and payments, build on-demand video libraries, host retreats, and run marketing campaigns via text and email. We also offer fully branded apps and websites, so studios can deliver a seamless, professional experience across every customer touchpoint.

We’ve raised $15M in Series A funding and are growing quickly. It’s a unique moment to join us—we’re building a category-defining company in a fast-moving space, and we’re looking for teammates who are excited to help shape the future of wellness.

**The Role:**

We’re looking for a Product Manager with strong fintech and payments expertise to lead the next generation of Arketa’s financial infrastructure — the systems that power how studios and wellness creators get paid. In this role, you’ll own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for payments, billing, payouts, and financial workflows across the platform.

You’ll partner closely with engineering, design, GTM, and leadership to build reliable, intuitive, revenue-critical products that reduce friction, increase trust, and help our customers scale. This is a high-impact, highly cross-functional role designed for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, loves simplifying complex financial systems, and wants to shape the future of how wellness businesses manage and move money.

**What You’ll Do:**

- Lead product strategy and roadmap for Arketa’s payments, billing, and financial infrastructure.

- Build and optimize financial tools including payouts, reconciliation, invoicing, refunds, dispute management, and subscription billing.

- Collaborate with engineering, design, and data to ship high-impact features that improve speed, reliability, and trust in our fintech systems.

- Drive product discovery through user interviews, data analysis, and cross-functional research to deeply understand the needs of studios and wellness creators.

- Partner with GTM teams to support launches, gather feedback, and ensure smooth adoption of new financial products.

- Develop a strong understanding of compliance, risk, fraud, KYC, and global payment requirements.

- Define and track KPIs for fintech experience, financial performance, and user satisfaction.

- Continuously improve our financial workflows to reduce friction, improve accuracy, and help our customers get paid faster.

**What We’re Looking For:**

- 3–6+ years of Product Management experience in fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure at a high-growth B2B SaaS or marketplace startup.

- Strong technical understanding of APIs, payment processors, ledgers, and financial systems.

- Experience working with external payment platforms (e.g., Stripe, Plaid, Adyen, Modern Treasury).

- Exceptional problem-solving skills — you simplify complexity and move quickly without sacrificing quality.

- A user-centric mindset and the ability to translate financial concepts into intuitive product experiences.

- Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment with ambiguous inputs and evolving priorities.

- Excellent communication and alignment skills across engineering, design, compliance, finance, and GTM teams.

- (Bonus) Experience supporting global payments, payout flows, risk management, or tax workflows.

- (Bonus) A passion for wellness, fitness, or building tools for small business owners.

**What We Offer:**

- Competitive Salary, Stock Options, and Performance-based Bonuses

- Comprehensive Medical, Vision and Dental Insurance

- Unlimited PTO

- Annual Company Offsites

- Wellness Reimbursement

- Catered Lunches/Snacks in NY

- Ownership and Opportunity for Advancement

For this role, the estimated annual base salary range is $160,000–$200,000, depending on experience and qualifications. In addition to base pay, we offer equity and performance-based bonuses as part of our total compensation package. We believe in compensating fairly and transparently, and we’re happy to provide more detail during the interview process.

Arketa is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to diversity in its workforce. We actively encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters innovation and creativity, and we welcome candidates who share our values of respect, collaboration, and excellence.

title: Summer Intern, Research Product Manager (RPM)
description:
**ABOUT ABUNDANT**

As the need for scaling data becomes the core bottleneck to progress, moving from general knowledge to domain expertise, and from chatbots to agents. Abundant is solving this by designing and operating simulation infrastructure where next-generation models learn to reason and solve complex problems.

 

Our team is composed of high-impact former founders, ML engineers, roboticists, and data leads from companies like Waymo and Google, with experience deploying models at 1B user scale. We partner with a majority of the top AI labs, frontier startups, and F500 enterprises to enable AGI, ASI, and physical intelligence.

**THE ROLE**

Research PM (RPM) is a role unique to Abundant. RPMs are PMs of the model, unlike traditional PMs who own an application or a feature. RPMs design and implement model capabilities, either as part of an AI lab, data lab, or other research organization. This is a founding-level role with outsized ownership.

As an RPM intern, you'll spend the summer working side-by-side with the Abundant founders to ensure our simulations are continuously pushing the boundaries of what frontier models can accomplish.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

- **Co-design capabilities of the model** : define areas of improvement for the model, along with the Researcher.

- **Perform literature review** : headroom analysis, identifying recent work in academic and industry circles.

- **Run experiments and benchmarks:** using our internal simulation stack and our open source tooling such as Oddish to define and hillclimb on the vertical.

- **Become the voice of the model user** : Talk to individual users and/or enterprises, in order to deeply understand where models and agents are underperforming, turning these insights into evaluation and training data.

- **Work on data pipelines** : internal tooling to support research operations.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- **Technically fluent** : Deep understanding of evaluations, RL, and how LLMs and Agents work.

- **Research-oriented** — Able to read papers and keep up with SOTA literature.

- **Extreme owner** — You have extreme agency and a founder mentality; you are resourceful and scrappy.

- **Creative problem solver** — You leverage creativity and research skills to design projects from the ground up.

- **Must be highly proficient** with coding agents such as Codex or Claude Code.

title: Senior Product Manager, Decision Intelligence
description:
Our Company

  

The workplace has undergone a complete transformation. Historically, occupancy was consistent; everyone worked in the office five days per week. But in today’s world, occupancy is inconsistent, unpredictable, and dynamic, as work has become more flexible than ever before. To make decisions with confidence, workplace, CRE, and facilities management leaders need a true understanding of how and when their spaces are used.

  

VergeSense is the company behind the world’s first and only Occupancy Intelligence Platform. Over 220 companies across 50 countries and 140M sqft rely on occupancy intelligence to make confident, fact-based optimization decisions to improve employee experience and decrease costs. VergeSense customers use our Occupancy Intelligence Platform, which is built on a foundation of the industry's most accurate occupancy sensors and other data sources, to right-size their portfolio, validate space planning and designs, optimize cleaning operations, and ensure their teams can always find spaces to work.

  

## **The Opportunity**

Every large company makes high-stakes decisions about their physical workplaces: which floors to consolidate, how to redesign space after a reorg, when to trigger a restack before the problem becomes urgent. Today, those decisions are made slowly, manually, and often too late. CRE teams pull data from multiple disconnected systems, build scenarios in spreadsheets, and deliver recommendations that are already stale.

VergeSense is changing that. We are the industry leader in workplace intelligence, with a sensor platform covering millions of square feet across Fortune 2000 enterprises. Our Large Spatial Model is trained on billions of data points and years of behavioral data, giving us an understanding of how people actually use space that no one else has.

Our Predictive Planning product turns that intelligence into decisions, compressing multi-step manual planning and operational workflows into AI-assisted experiences for corporate real estate teams.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own one of these workflows end-to-end. The PM who thrives here is someone drawn to the full problem space: how enterprises make decisions about physical space, where AI can replace broken manual processes, and what it takes to build trust in AI-generated recommendations at the enterprise level.

**What You Will Do**

- Own a planning or operational workflow end-to-end: vision, customer discovery, roadmap, engineering partnership, and commercial outcome.

- Define where AI stops and the human decision starts. Our agents are goal-seeking systems that detect planning triggers, assemble data, and generate scenarios. You will set the automation boundaries and design the human review experience.

- Build products that work with messy enterprise data. HRIS feeds, badge systems, lease records, and occupancy sensors all tell part of the story. You will design for the reality that clean data is the exception.

- Ship the first version within your first two quarters. This is a hands-on building role with real commercial pressure and named enterprise accounts waiting for the product. You will be in the tool daily, not managing from a distance.

- Partner closely with the existing product team. You will work alongside a strong GTM-oriented PM and a design leader who together own adjacent workflows.

 

**What This Role Requires**

- 6+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with demonstrated experience owning data-intensive or analytics products.

- You have taken a complex, multi-step manual workflow and shipped a product that meaningfully automated it. This is the single most important signal we are looking for.

- Experience building products that involve data from multiple enterprise systems. You understand that clean data is the exception and you design for the failure modes.

- Demonstrated ability to own a product domain end-to-end: vision, discovery, roadmap, engineering partnership, and commercial outcome.

- Quantitative fluency. You define success metrics before building. You can evaluate model outputs, catch wrong answers, and translate data quality problems into product decisions.

- Executive communication quality. You lead with the recommendation. You have presented to C-suite or board-level audiences. You produce tight decision documents, not exploratory overviews.

- Experience with prioritization under commercial pressure. You know how to sequence a roadmap against named deals and pipeline value, not just user needs.

  

Benefits

  

• A high-impact role in an emerging industry leader

• Competitive compensation and equity

• Employer-sponsored medical

• Dental and vision insurance (dependent on location)

• Open Vacation policy: take time off when you need it

  

We value people from all walks of life who exhibit kindness, curiosity, discipline, humility, and passion to excel at what they do. If you would like to contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
This is one of the highest-impact roles at Broccoli. In this role, you'll shape what we build, in what order, and how successful the rollouts are.

Broccoli is at an exciting growth stage with constant product tradeoffs. New products to build. A steady stream of feature requests from existing customers. Two different customer profiles: enterprise operators and independent SMBs. Plus rapid expansion into new verticals within home services. Every week involves hard calls about what gets built and what doesn't. You'll own those calls day-to-day and help the founders make the bigger strategic ones. When something ships, you own the rollout to customers, the CS team, and the sales team, plus the metrics and the honest answer to whether it actually worked.

We are especially looking for someone who can do two things well. \
First: get deep into our customers' businesses. We build with design partners, embedding with their teams and truly understanding their businesses. We prioritize based on which AI agents will have the biggest P&L impact for them. \
Second: know what's possible with AI. Customers ask for what they've seen SaaS products do. You should be building toward what AI makes possible, which is almost always something far better than what anyone thought to request.

### **What you'll own**

* **AI PM agent:** build and leverage an agent that ingests tickets, call transcripts, Linear, and product metrics and surfaces what matters most, so your time goes to synthesis and judgment, not information gathering
* **Prioritization:** manage tradeoffs across new products, feature requests, enterprise vs. SMB needs, and expanding verticals; give the team a clear, defensible view of what's most important and why
* **Founder leverage**: bring enough structure and insight to strategic conversations that the founders can make faster, better decisions on the hard calls
* **Specs and mockups:** write specs built around the "why" and produce basic mockups that give engineering enough to move fast
* **Launch and go-to-market:** coordinate with customer success, sales, and marketing when features ship; ensuring the right enablement, release notes, and customer comms are in place
* **Metrics:** define what success looks like for every feature, ensure the right things get tracked, and review outcomes after every launch

### **Who we're looking for**

**Must-haves**

* High-agency: you bring structure to ambiguity, move without being told, and own outcomes end to end
* Strong business judgment: you get to the real need underneath a customer request and prioritize based on P&L impact, not loudest voice
* AI-first: you default to asking what's now possible, not what's been done before, and you've built agents or AI-powered workflows yourself
* **Excited to work in-office five days a week to collaborate closely with the founders and the team**

**Strong plus**

* Former founder, or a PM who has operated like one: you've made calls with incomplete information, owned outcomes, and stayed close to customers throughout
* Experience at a high-growth B2B startup (Series A to C)
* Home services or field service management experience

**Not a fit**

* PM experience primarily in process management, stakeholder alignment, or sprint facilitation
* Never owned a product outcome end to end

### **Why Join Us?**

* **Impact from Day 1:** Own features end-to-end for hundreds of real businesses.
* **Category-Creation:** Shape how AI employees run the $600B home services industry.
* **Ultra-Fast Execution:** Ship and iterate 3x faster than competitors.
* **Small Team, Big Ownership:** Work directly with the founders and see your code in production daily.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:

**Why are we hiring this role?**

* Our customers are financial institutions demanding features and product enhancements faster than we can keep up. You will help us close the sale, become their trusted advisor, and act as the ambassador to Tank’s product and engineering teams to maximize their success.

**What you’ll do**

* Own end-to-end implementation & success, picking up customer relationships mid sales funnel and seeing them through full implementation
* Monitor and improve core engagement metrics – turn users into multi-product, power users

* Define and scope software and financial engineering solutions to meet customer needs

**Compensation**

* Uncapped, self-directed PTO and paid parental leave

title: Product Manager
description:
# **Why Casca?**

Casca is building AGI for banking. We’re replacing decades-old legacy systems with AI-native technology that automates 90% of the manual work humans once had to do.

You'll own a product vertical end-to-end. You'll work directly with our engineering team and bank customers to turn complex lending workflows into elegant, AI-native experiences. You'll make consequential decisions about what we build and why.

Our bottleneck isn't demand. It's delivery speed. Banks keep pulling us into new areas faster than we can build. We need people who can own big problems, work directly with sophisticated customers, and help us ship faster.

## **What You'll Do**

- **Define product strategy for your vertical.** Make hard prioritization calls. Shape the roadmap based on customer needs, business impact, and technical feasibility.

- **Spend time with bank customers.** Understand their workflows, pain points, and the regulatory constraints they operate within. Build products that actually solve problems.

- **Work closely with engineers** to make good tradeoffs between speed, quality, and scope. Understand technical complexity.

- **Own the full lifecycle:** requirements, development, QA, rollout, iteration. Measure what matters. Fix what doesn't work.

- **Move fast.** Juggle multiple priorities, make decisions with incomplete information, adapt quickly as we learn.

## **What We're Looking For**

- 4+ years in product management in fast-paced, tech-driven environments (we're especially excited by prior startup experience)

- Track record of shipping customer-facing products that users actually use

- Strong analytical skills. You use data to make decisions, not to justify them after the fact.

- Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain complex ideas simply.

- Experience with AI/ML products, financial services, or enterprise software

## What you'll get: 

- **Impact & Ownership** : A unique opportunity to shape the future of banking through AI, owning end-to-end product initiatives.

- **Collaborative Environment** : Work alongside a talented and passionate team that values continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

- **Competitive Compensation** : Includes salary, benefits, and potential equity in a fast-growing startup.

- **Professional Growth** : Access to resources and mentorship to expand your skill set, influence strategy, and accelerate your career.

- **Culture of Innovation** : We encourage risk-taking, learning from failures, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in fintech.

title: Strategy and Research Associate
description:
**About the role**

Corgi is vertically integrating the entire insurance industry. We design, underwrite, price, and issue insurance directly – no brokers, no third-party administrators. Insurance is the largest unautomated industry in financial services, and we're rebuilding it from the ground up using AI. We've raised $268M from Kindred, TCV, and others to do so.

This requires not just speed, but also rigor. This means deep research, structured thinking, and high-quality written execution across everything we do. This role sits at the center of that effort.

You’ll work across new product lines, regulatory filings, and internal initiatives with a focus on research, analysis, and documentation. If you’re someone who enjoys digging into complex topics, producing clear outputs, and owning high-stakes work from idea to submission, this role is for you.

Building something great requires working hard. We are in the office 7 days a week. We are meritocratic with very high standards. If you don't meet them, you'll get cut. But if you deliver, you have unlimited scope to grow. 

**What you'll do**

* Draft and manage regulatory filings, applications, and supporting documentation.
* Own written deliverables end-to-end (briefs, filings, internal docs, external materials).
* Support new product and entity launches through research, documentation, and coordination.
* Interface with regulators, vendors, and partners to gather information and move processes forward.

**What we're looking for**

* You’ve built or owned something from zero (startup, research initiative, project, etc.).
* Exceptional researcher and clear writer.
* Highly detail-oriented: you care about precision, accuracy, and completeness.
* Comfortable working through ambiguity, but instinctively create structure.
* Able to manage multiple projects and deadlines with high accountability.
* Low ego, high agency.

**Bonus points**

* Prior legal or regulatory experience.
* Prior experience at an early-stage startup.
* Background in a high-intensity environment (law, consulting, banking, startup, sport, military).
* You use AI to 10x your output while maintaining high standards.

title: Founding Actuary
description:
**Location:** Atlanta, GA / Chicago, IL / Salt Lake City, UT / Remote (US)

**Experience:** 6+ years

**Compensation:** $150,000 - $250,000 base + \~0.01% equity (\~$120,000)

**Visa Sponsorship:** US citizen/visa holders only

 **About Corgi**

Corgi is an insurance holding company forming Risk Retention Groups and captive insurance entities. We use technology to streamline operations, but the core of what we do is underwriting and managing risk. We have raised $108M and are actively standing up our first insurance vehicles.

### **About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced actuary to be our first in-house hire for the function. Day to day, you would handle feasibility studies, reserving, and pricing. You would not be doing this alone: we work with outside counsel, captive managers, and consulting actuaries who are already in place. There will be budget to bring on junior actuaries to support you.

### **What You Would Work On**

* Loss reserving and rate development for commercial programs.
* Pricing for new lines and states.
* Regulatory filings and interfacing with state departments of insurance.
* Feasibility studies for new RRG and captive formations.
* Coordinating with counsel and captive managers on deadlines.

### **Over Time**

* Serve as appointed/opining actuary across entities.
* Help shape reinsurance program structure and pricing.
* Present to the board on reserves and projections.
* Bring on and mentor junior actuaries.

### **Required Qualifications**

* FCAS or ACAS + MAAA.
* 6+ years of actuarial experience.
* Some prior captive or RRG work.
* Comfortable working across multiple lines of business.

### **Nice to Have**

* Appointed actuary experience for RRGs or captives.
* Multi-state regulatory filing background.
* Reinsurance pricing experience.
* Familiarity with Python, R, or similar tools.

•   Equity options.

•   Direct ownership of a critical function in a high-growth insurance business.

title: Tax Accountant (CPA, EA, or >6 years of experience)
description:
Soraban is building an AI tax workflow automation software for modern accounting firms. Our platform helps accounting firms automate client intake, document processing, tax preparation workflows, and service delivery. 

We are looking for a tax accountants who:

1. are tired of going through tax seasons every year trying to maximize billing hours.
2. are excited to redefine the modern tax engagement.

This role will start out by helping us improve our product experience via working with our ambitious product team. This will involve some combination of responsibilities (but not limited to), training our proprietary AI model, providing product feedback, and doing R&D work with tax workflows as we scale to serve more types of accounting firms.

### **Requirements**

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in tax preparation within **mid-market or large tax accounting firms (50+ employees)**, and a deep understanding of the **entire tax filing lifecycle**, including:

* Client onboarding and data collection
* Document handling and review
* Tax preparation and review workflows
* Delivery of returns to clients
* Filing with federal and state tax authorities

### **What You’ll Own and Drive**

* **End-to-End Flow Testing:** Test the entire workflow including client intake, data collection, document handling, preparation, review, delivery, and filing.
* **Scenario Simulation:** Simulate real-world scenarios based on actual work performed inside mid-market or large tax firms based on your experience
* **Gap and Edge Case Identification:** Identify workflow conflicts, inefficiencies, missing steps, and areas where the system does not align with real firm processes.
* **Structured Feedback and Documentation:** Provide detailed, actionable feedback to improve usability, accuracy, and workflow alignment with real firms. Document findings clearly and concisely.

### **What We’re Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with **CCH Axcess or ProSystem fx** (Must)
* Deep familiarity with tax workflow processes used by mid-market or large firms
* Experience across the full tax lifecycle: onboarding, document intake, preparation, review, delivery, and filing
* Ability to identify workflow gaps, inefficiencies, and edge cases
* Ability to provide structured, detailed feedback on system behavior

**Preferred / Plus**

* CPA or EA license
* Experience working for more than one CPA firms
* Familiarity with evaluating other tax/audit/accounting automation will be a bonus

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
**About Stepful** :

Stepful is reimagining allied healthcare training by offering affordable, online, instructor-led, and AI-supported programs that help learners—regardless of background or circumstance—launch high-demand healthcare careers.

In addition to our direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. Our graduates, including Medical Assistants, Pharmacy Technicians, Nurses, and more, form the talent pipelines at major employers like CVS, NY-Presbyterian, HCA, Providence, and Walgreens.

Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with [<u>a recent $31.5M Series B led by Oak HC/FT</u>](https://www.stepful.com/post/stepful-announces-series-b). [<u>We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025</u>](https://www.stepful.com/post/stepful-named-1-edtech-company-in-us-top-10-globally-times-2025-list).

We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare careers for those who need them most

**Our values** :

We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

- **Care first** : We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.

- **Learn quickly** : We test, learn with data, and iterate.

- **Build together** : We win when we rely on each other.

- **Own it** : We show up, take initiative, and show pride.

## **The role:**

As a Staff Product Manager on our team, you’ll be responsible for crafting delightful, data-driven best in class product experiences to ensure our students are successful from signup to graduation to ultimately find their dream job. This could include anything from growing our proprietary learning platform, improving the efficiency of our coaches and instructors, or building 0 to 1 products. 

## **You will be successful if you:**

- Care first: We do everything it takes for our students to succeed. 

- Learn quickly: We test, learn with data, and iterate 

- Build together: We win when we rely on each other 

- Own it: We show up, we take initiative, and pride

## **What you’ll do:**

- Lead the strategy for how we can best prioritize our coach and instructor time to effectively work with large and varied student populations

- Strategize how AI can help us move quicker and deliver better personalized experiences across the board

- Deeply understand our students, instructors and coaches and be their voice across our team 

- Work closely with design, engineering, data, ops and other cross-functional partners to learn quickly and ship quickly.

- Effectively communicate product roadmap & vision and clearly managing priorities and tradeoffs

## **This job is for you if you have:**

- You have 10+ years of consumer facing product management experience 

- You are highly analytical (proficient in SQL & data visualizations) with strong communication skills to relay those insights

- Ability to build relationships and influence decisions at various levels across all different team members

- You aren’t afraid to roll up your sleeves and be hands on to get the job done 

- Bias to action with the ability to consider trade-offs and make decisions amongst competing priorities 

## **Bonus points if you have:**

- Previous startup experience especially at B2B2C or B2C EdTech/Healthcare 

- Experience working in consulting

- Experience with A/B testing or other experiment/data driven product development organizations

- Understanding of technical aspects of software development (ex. should be able to search through GitHub) 

## **Interview Process:**

Step 1: Intro Call with Talent Acquisition Lead

Step 2: Call with hiring manager (past project deep dive and mini case)

Step 3: Onsite interview at office in SoHo, NYC

##   
**Compensation:**

New Hire Base Salary Bands:   
Staff I - $191,000-$241,000  
Staff II - $201,000-$254,000  
  
Please note we do not have a bonus structure at this time so all cash compensation will come in the form of base salary. The total compensation package will also include our benefits package and an equity (ISOs) package.

Compensation for this role will fall within the pay range listed and will be determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications as well as interview evaluation. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

**Stepful is proud to be an equal opportunity employer**. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Cambio is a software platform that drives world-class real estate decarbonization. We help commercial real estate owners and tenants bring their real estate portfolios to net-zero using a machine learning-driven, end-to-end real estate sustainability platform. Our mission is to take the real estate industry into the climate action era.

Cambio is looking for a Senior to Lead level Product Manager to lead the development of our revenue and compliance product lines. This role is ideal for someone with a strong track record of launching compliance and/or ROI-Tracking products, who thrives at the intersection of product strategy and customer value.

This is a high-impact role critical to driving our mission to decarbonize commercial real estate at scale.

**What you will be doing**

- Translate real-world decarbonization and building management challenges into scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.

- Prioritize ruthlessly to balance long-term growth bets with near-term product impact.

- Work collaboratively across customer success, sales, and partnerships to ensure roadmap alignment with customer and market needs.

- **Customer-Centric Product Design:** Engage with customers to deeply understand their pain points and needs. Use this insight to inform product design and development, ensuring that our solutions are not only functional but also delightful to use.

- **Data-Driven Decision Making:** Leverage data analytics to inform product decisions. Set and monitor KPIs to measure product success and drive continuous improvement.

- **Go-to-Market Execution:** Partner with GTM Teams to develop and execute go-to-market strategies, ensuring successful product launches that resonate with target customers.

- **Stakeholder Management:** Serve as the primary point of contact for product-related inquiries, managing expectations and providing regular updates to stakeholders, including senior leadership and external partners.

**Qualifications**

- **Experience:** 5+ years of product management experience in building web apps, ideally for Saas, B2B.

- **Customer Focus:** Proven track record of delivering customer-centric products that solve real-world problems. Experience engaging with customers and translating their needs into product features.

- **Leadership:** Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and inspire cross-functional teams. Experience leading product development in a fast-paced, agile environment.

- **Communication Skills:** Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- **Analytical Skills:** Data-driven approach to decision-making, with experience using analytics to inform product strategy and measure success.

- **Team Player** : Commitment to the team's success and collaborative working style.

**Logistics:**

- **Work Authorization:** Authorization to work in the United States.

- **Location:** Must be based in San Francisco or New York City/ We are a hybrid team with a 2-3 days in office policy.

- **Compensation:** This role is currently set at a salary range of ~$175,000-$190,000 plus equity.

title: Forward-Deployed Product Manager (US-Remote)
description:
About Tailor

Tailor is a pioneer in Headless ERP technology. Our platform empowers companies to build internal workflows that adapt to their unique needs — faster, smarter, and developer-first.

---

About the Role

We’re looking for a Forward-Deployed Product Manager to serve as the key bridge between our clients and internal product and engineering teams. You’ll play a vital role in extracting requirements, managing communications, and supporting successful deployments led by the technical team. This client-facing, high-context role focuses on clarity, alignment, and speed.

---

What You’ll Do

* Gather and Clarify Requirements
  * Work directly with clients to understand business needs and pain points
  * Translate those needs into clear, prioritized requirements for engineers
* Own the Client Relationship
  * Act as the main point of contact for client-facing conversations during onboarding, scoping, and delivery
  * Proactively manage expectations, timelines, and feedback loops.
* Support Internal Teams
  * Provide context and clarity to engineers to help ensure smooth delivery.\
    Ensure alignment between what was requested, what’s being built, and what’s being shipped.
* Build Repeatable Patterns
  * Identify recurring client needs and help formalize templates, docs, or processes to streamline future deployments.
  * Help improve internal handoff flows, requirement intake, and communication patterns.
* Shape the Product Roadmap
* Distill recurring customer insights into strategic themes, prioritized high-impact features, and propose data-driven roadmap that advances Tailor’s vision.

  ---

What We’re Looking For

* 2+ years in a Software Company

title: 0→1 Product Leader
description:
A Y Combinator/Imagine K12 company, ClassDojo's long-term goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love. The ClassDojo app is the #1 communication app for micro-communities of K-8 teachers, children and families globally; they use it to stay connected, sharing what's happening through the school day through photos, videos, messages, and activities. The company is now helping kids get learning experiences they love, beyond school. Today, ClassDojo is used by 95% of pre K-8 schools in the US, as well as in a further 180 countries.

As our 0→1 Product Leader, you’ll create and validate new products reaching tens of millions of children and families, building a global consumer education business. You’ll grow ClassDojo from where we are to our next major milestones: reaching 100 million+ active families, and 100 million+ in revenue, while deepening our brand love. 

You’ll do this by rolling up your sleeves to discover opportunities for alternative revenue models, validate and invalidate these, and execute on one or more with the most promise. You’ll work closely with our founders, head of product, and other product teams to generate and test exciting ideas quickly and creatively. You work at both a strategic and tactical level, turning data, research, and intuition into products that people want and love to use. In the process, you optimize for rapid learning by uncovering unique insights or theses, exploring divergent prototypes, and testing value and viability with users to converge to simple, elegant, validated prototypes and products.

Your work will identify and build new business lines, taking them from 0 to 1, drive growth, and should help further our mission to provide educational experiences kids and families love. 


**Competencies**

* Experience discovering and building new consumer products, achieving product-market fit
* Experience monetizing consumer products (ideally subscription products or marketplaces)
* Experience as a founder / equivalent level of accountability
* Strong grasp of product strategy
* Strong product intuition
* Experience conducting user research and developing strong user understanding via many methods
* Strong business skills, comfort with basic forecasting and managing of revenue, expenses, and general operations
* Strong quantitative skills and comfort with data and statistics, creating/refining hypotheses by exploring user data
* Works well in resource-constrained environments
* Structured problem-solving ability
* Good judgment and strong thought partner for head of product and CEO on product and revenue strategy
* Moves faster than is comfortable - an instigator
* Clear, concise written and spoken communication
* Strong follow-through
 
**Bonus competencies:**

* Experience with brand
* Experience growing consumer products internationally
* Experience at a high quality culture tech company
* 7+ years of professional experience
* Americas timezones
 
**About ClassDojo**

ClassDojo's mission is to bring communities together, and help them create an education experience their children love. Founded in 2011 (ImagineK12 / Y Combinator) and based in San Francisco, California, ClassDojo started as a communication app: a simple way for teachers, families, and children to share the magic of the school day through photos, videos, and messages. It creates a close-knit classroom community, and exciting, inspiring and creative classrooms and homes for kids. We’re one of the fastest growing education companies of all time, used and loved by tens of millions of teachers, families and children in 90% of K-8 schools in the US, and 180 other countries.

You can read more about our vision to change education from the ground up here: https://medium.com/@samchaudhary/https-medium-com-samchaudhary-how-to-change-education-from-the-ground-up-f82b8f3e4b95.

**The Team**

We believe focused, talented, non-hierarchical teams can achieve a surprising amount: https://blog.ycombinator.com/its-surprising-how-much-small-teams-can-get-done-sam-chaudhary-of-classdojo/. Our team is made up of talented, motivated, intense and interesting people from around the world, with deep backgrounds in education, as well as from leading consumer internet organizations like Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Uber, Y Combinator and more. We’re building a company that is pioneering the future of education, and one that is the kind of place we’ve all always wanted to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here.

**Diversity**

ClassDojo’s vision is to give every child on Earth an education they love. We strongly feel the best way to do this is to work with people from diverse backgrounds that truly reflect the world. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. In accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are happy to accommodate any disabilities or special needs. We hire both locally in San Francisco, and distributed teammates around the world.

If you're interested in pioneering the future of education at massive scale, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Founding Technical Product Manager
description:
**Founding Technical Product Manager**

Knowtex • In-Person/Hybrid (San Francisco)

## **About Knowtex**

Knowtex is building the clinical intelligence platform for clinicians, transforming the way medicine is practiced, and how patient care is completed. Founded by Stanford AI scientists with deep federal, clinical, and technical experience, we’re experiencing explosive growth across both commercial health systems and government healthcare. Our ambient documentation platform scales to thousands of clinicians across hundreds of specialties, and we’re serving clinicians across the country. We’re at an inflection point where cutting-edge AI meets real clinical impact—giving clinicians hours back each day to focus on what matters most: their patients.

## **Position Overview**

Knowtex is hiring a founding Technical Product Manager to own critical product areas at the intersection of AI, clinical workflows, and healthcare infrastructure. These roles require strong technical depth, the ability to work directly with clinicians and healthcare administrators to understand complex workflows, and the skill to translate those insights into clear engineering requirements and product strategy.

## **Key Responsibilities**

- Define product roadmap, prioritize features, and drive execution for your product area

- Conduct discovery with clinicians, healthcare administrators, and IT leaders to deeply understand clinical workflows and pain points

- Translate complex clinical and operational requirements into clear engineering specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria

- Partner closely with engineering, AI/ML, and design teams to ship high-quality products on tight timelines

- Own product metrics, conduct data analysis, and use quantitative and qualitative signals to drive decisions

- Manage cross-functional stakeholders including clinical operations, compliance, sales, and customer success

- Evaluate build vs. buy vs. partner decisions for integrations and capabilities

- Communicate product vision and progress to leadership, customers, and external partners

## **Required Qualifications**

- 2+ years of product management experience with a strong technical foundation

- Ability to read and reason about code, APIs, data models, and system architecture

- Experience working directly with clinicians, healthcare administrators, or clinical operations teams

- Demonstrated ability to distill ambiguous, complex stakeholder needs into actionable engineering requirements

- Strong analytical skills—comfortable with SQL, product analytics tools, and data-driven decision making

- Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to present to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Experience working in fast-paced startup environments with high ownership and autonomy

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience)

## **Preferred Qualifications**

_ **Government & Federal Healthcare:** _

- Experience with federal healthcare (VA, DoD, MHS) or government contracting

- Familiarity with FedRAMP, ATO processes, IL4/IL5 compliance, or FISMA

- Experience managing enterprise-scale onboarding and change management programs

- Understanding of federal procurement processes and stakeholder dynamics

_ **Clinical Automation:** _

- Experience with EMR/EHR platforms (Epic, Cerner, OncoEMR) or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7)

- Background in clinical documentation, medical coding (CPT, ICD-10), or revenue cycle management

- Experience with NLP/AI products, particularly in accuracy measurement and hallucination reduction

- Understanding of clinical workflow design across medical specialties

_ **Clinical Intelligence:** _

- Experience with clinical decision support, clinical trial matching, or evidence-based guidelines (NCCN, ASCO)

- Background in health informatics, biomedical data, or life sciences technology

- Experience building AI/ML-powered products, chatbots, or knowledge retrieval systems

- Familiarity with regulatory considerations for clinical AI (FDA SaMD, clinical validation)

## **Technical Environment**

- AWS (GovCloud for federal deployments)

- Python, Node.js / TypeScript backend services

- React frontend (internal tools and dashboards)

- Healthcare data formats (FHIR, HL7, JSON, CSV)

- AI/ML pipelines, LLM-based products, and NLP systems

- Event-driven and asynchronous processing architectures

## **Compensation & Benefits**

- Competitive salary

- Meaningful equity compensation

- Unlimited PTO

- Premium health, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) plan

- Work model: In Person/Hybrid (SF Based)

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to help us shape the future of Customer Support and Experience, someone who combines exceptional design sensibility with product ownership instincts - a truly exceptional talent to take over all things product scoping, client feature requests, and UX/UI -- from understanding user requirements to the entire look and feel of our platform and brand. The primary requirements are the ability to be able to understand the app as an end user and from there, create clear and logical user stories, workflows, and actions on Figma. We are also looking for someone particularly strong in information architecture, as our product surfaces a lot of information across different dashboards and views that need to feel effortless to navigate.

As a founding member of the team, you'll make a significant impact as we scale our revenue and operations globally to cross $2M in ARR in the next year. 

This role is in-office 5 days a week.

Your responsibilities will include: 

* Partner with the founders to define and prioritize the roadmap, balancing user needs, business impact, and technical feasibility.
* Work directly with users and translate their needs into tangible user flows and actionable product decisions, directly impacting product direction.
* Create flows, prototypes and high-fidelity visuals for your features and improvements.
* Lead end-to-end product design projects and work closely with engineers to ensure high-quality implementation.
* Help evolve our brand and visuals and implement across our product interface and website for marketing, new launches, and fun experiments.

You’re likely a good fit if you:

* Move fast, have a strong bias for action and don’t shy away from stepping on toes.
* Live and breath pixels with excellent taste for well-crafted interaction design and UI details.
* Have worked in a high-growth, fast-paced environment (ideally another startup) and can drive things forward with relatively little oversight.
* We are remote but value presence and face-time so we make sure to use our online channels to communicate often. 
* We offer high quality healthcare (medical, dental, etc.), flexible working hours, and all the required office setup/tools.
* Have experience in product management.

Nice-to-haves:

* Coding experience or familiarity with TypeScript.

If interested, reach out with a couple of sentences about you, links to your previous work/portfolio (live products are best!) and what you want to do for us starting next week. This is super important - any application without this will be ignored.

**About the interview process**

First, we'll have an introductory call to learn more about what you're looking for, the role and whether it's a good fit.

We’ll then give you the opportunity to learn more about us and speak to a couple of the founding members of our team.
