title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
### **Who We Are**

Popl is defining a new category we call In-Person Go-To-Market.

We help revenue teams turn real-world interactions — trade shows, conferences, field events, and meetings — into measurable pipeline and revenue. Our AI-native platform powers event lead capture, enrichment, and real-time CRM sync, transforming every badge scan into a high-quality, actionable lead.

In a world where digital channels are saturated, we're building the infrastructure that makes in-person GTM measurable, scalable, and revenue-driving. Our mission is simple: help companies around the world turn in-person events into a measurable & scalable growth channel.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for an AI-Powered Product Marketing Manager: a storyteller who uses AI as a force multiplier. You craft the narrative, then use AI to distribute it across channels, arm everyone around you to tell it, and move at a speed that would otherwise require a team of five.

This is someone who has built AI workflows, not just someone who uses AI tools. You've worked with the Anthropic or OpenAI API, shipped things other people actually use, and figured out how to make yourself operate like a team. You bring strong PMM instincts and you apply them through systems you've built, not manual effort you repeat.

This is also someone who runs toward the white space. You identify where the biggest impact is and you go execute it, without waiting to be pointed in a direction. You bring proven product marketing playbooks you've run before, and you're just as excited to build new ones from scratch.

Most importantly, you care about the story. You get genuinely excited about telling the story of Popl, the problems we solve, and the outcomes of solving them.

This is Popl's first dedicated Product Marketing hire. You'll report directly to the CPO and sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. You'll own the product narrative: how we position and launch, how we tell the story in the field, and how we educate customers so they actually get value.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Own product update and launch narratives: Translate what Prod/Eng ships into engaging, customer-facing content that resonates with the right audience across email, LinkedIn, and the website.
* Build and maintain Sales and Customer Success enablement content: create decks, one-pagers, and battle cards that help our Sales and Customer Success teams walk into conversations with confidence.
* Support webinars and customer education: Help plan and execute webinars that teach customers how to get more out of Popl and showcase new capabilities.
* Tighten the feedback loop with leadership: You'll be embedded in how the product works, as well as our sales, marketing and success systems, to ensure every piece of content reflects what's true about the product and what customers actually care about.
* Use AI across all of the above: Build repeatable workflows that let you move faster and scale output without scaling headcount.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 3+ years in product marketing or a closely adjacent B2B SaaS role: You understand the B2B buyer journey and know how to create content that moves people at different stages.
* AI-native, not just AI-curious: You've built workflows, not just used tools. You know how to apply AI across research, content creation, and go-to-market execution without losing your voice or your judgment.
* A natural storyteller who can write: Sharp copy and strategic narrative in equal measure. Comfortable directing AI to accelerate output without losing your voice.
* Public proof of storytelling: active presence on LinkedIn or other platforms demonstrating sharing content with the world and the world engaging back with you
* Multi-persona fluency: You shift tone and framing based on the audience instinctively.
* Extreme ownership and initiative: This role is new and intentionally broad. You spot gaps, propose solutions, and execute without waiting to be told.
* Strong creative instincts: You push past the obvious first draft and find the angle that actually works.

### **Nice to Haves**

* Experience marketing to event marketers, field marketers, or revenue operations teams
* Familiarity with CRM or martech ecosystems like Salesforce, HubSpot, or Marketo
* Comfort with webinar production and live content formats
* Design fluency: comfortable in Figma, able to direct visual assets, and experienced working with or managing small creative teams

### **Why join us?**

* Be part of a rocket-ship startup redefining how professionals connect and grow.
* Work closely with experienced leaders and cross-functional teams to shape our financial strategy.
* Make a measurable impact in a role critical to our long-term success.
* Fully remote
* Competitive salary
* Meaningful equity
* Full insurance & benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* $150 monthly wellness credit
* Constant daily learning

title: Product Manager
description:

* Experience in fintech, regtech, or trading

* Healthcare, dental, vision, etc.
* Housing stipend for team members living in FiDi

description:
**Job Title**: IT Administrator\
**Department**: IT/ Product \
**Reports to**: COO / Director of Compliance 

### **About LunaJoy**

Founded by Sipra Laddha and Shama Rathi, two psychiatrists who saw the gaps in maternal mental health care firsthand, LunaJoy is building the infrastructure they wished they had.

LunaJoy is a leading provider of mental health services, specializing in supporting women through their mental wellness journey. We offer holistic therapy and medication management to help women overcome challenges like postpartum mental health issues. Our dedicated team of professionals works in a collaborative, flexible, and remote environment, ensuring comprehensive care for our clients. We are rapidly expanding and committed to improving access to quality mental health services across the U.S.

### **Job Overview**

At LunaJoy, we’re building world-class, accessible mental healthcare for women. We’re scaling fast—and legacy healthcare technology just can’t keep up. Slow, clunky systems are getting in the way, and we’re here to fix that.

In your first 90 days, you will successfully lead us through our SOC 2 Type 2 audit and automate 90% of clinician onboarding.

This is not a maintenance role. You’ll build and own our compliance posture, leading SOC 2 Type 1 & 2 certification while overseeing our full software stack. From advanced security configuration in Island Browser to clinical operations in AdvancedMD, you’ll have broad ownership and real impact as a department of one.

As part of the LunaJoy team, you will play an essential role in directly contributing to support the mental health journey of one million women with purpose-driven innovation, unwavering compassion, and transformative care. You will need speed to adapt quickly and efficiently, and the drive to be 1% better every day, constantly striving for improvement. Additionally, you will demonstrate compassion and contribute to a positive work environment by giving and getting joy in your daily interactions. These values will enable you to effectively contribute to important areas of focus and responsibility.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

### **1. Compliance & Governance**

* **Compliance & Governance (SOC 2, HIPAA)**: Led SOC 2 Type 1 & 2 readiness and certification, aligning security programs with HIPAA requirements. You have successfully led a startup through a SOC 2 Type 2 audit from scratch.
* **Policy Management:** Authored and maintained clear, actionable security policies that drive real-world compliance.
* **Audit & Monitoring:** Established continuous monitoring to ensure audit evidence reflects actual system behavior.
* **Documentation:** Built and maintained living technical documentation, keeping legacy processes accurate and up to date.

### **2. SaaS Management**

* **Identity & Access Management:** Owned platform access using Zero Trust principles and strong credential controls.
* **Onboarding & Offboarding:** Provisioned and deprovisioned users and providers quickly across systems to maintain security.
* **Google Workspace Administration:** Full administrator ownership, including user lifecycle, SSO, OU setup, context-aware access, and audit reviews.
* **SaaS Cost Optimization:** Optimized licenses and subscriptions, removing unused seats and negotiating renewals to control spend.

### **3. EMR Administration (AdvancedMD)**

* **Platform Expertise (AdvancedMD):** Full ownership of the AdvancedMD platform across clinical and operational workflows.
* **Operations:** Managed user access, provider scheduling, appointments, and reporting.
* **Troubleshooting:** Independently resolved platform issues end-to-end, serving as the in-house expert.

### **4. Network, Browser & Web Infrastructure**

* Island Browser Administrator: Architect and maintain a Zero Trust environment using Island Browser as a primary secure gateway for all clinical and administrative staff
* Cloud Infrastructure: Oversight of usage and security controls of AWS & Google Cloud infrastructure.
* Web & DNS: Manage domains in GoDaddy (DNS management, renewals, domain reputation).

### **5. IT Support & Efficiency**

* **Help Desk & IT Support:** Delivered responsive IT support for employees and physicians, resolving access, connectivity, and day-to-day technical issues efficiently.
* **AI Integration:** Leveraged AI tools to accelerate outcomes and embed best practices across projects.
* **Project Management:** Used Asana to plan initiatives, track progress, and maintain clear, ongoing visibility for stakeholders.

#### **Qualifications and Skills:**

### **Technical Requirements**

* **Compliance Experience:** Supported SOC 2 Type 1 & 2 and HIPAA compliance through practical, audit-ready security programs.
* **Platform Mastery:** Advanced administration of AdvancedMD (or similar EMRs), Google Workspace (Enterprise), Island Browser, and Keeper Security.
* **Cloud Experience:** Designed and managed secure, scalable cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

**Professional Strengths**

* **Independent Operator:** Comfortable owning complex technical challenges end-to-end.

### **About Luna Joy**

Luna Joy is a leading provider of mental health services, specializing in supporting women through their mental wellness journey. Our dedicated team of professionals works in a collaborative, flexible, and remote environment, ensuring comprehensive care for our clients. title: Product Lead, Commerce
description:
## **Meet Method**

Method has built the most modern way to connect to consumer financial accounts. Combining real-time liability connectivity with instant payment execution, Method’s API is designed to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use.  
  
We have helped 45+ million users connect 350+ million liability accounts credential-less and processed over $2.5B in payments, helping users save millions in interest. One in every three credit cards in the United States is in the Method ecosystem and leading financial institutions like SoFi, Bilt, Cleo, Sezzle, Figure & Aven rely on our APIs to build magical experiences for millions of consumers.  
  
We’re a team of 50+ people spread across offices in Austin, SF, New York City and Washington D.C! We’re excited to continue the momentum working alongside our investors and advisors from Andreessen Horowitz, Emergence Capital, Y Combinator, Avra, and Ardent. To learn more about us, check out our [<u>blog</u>](https://methodfi.com/resources/company-updates)!

##   
**About the role**

Method has three main customer verticals: Commerce, Lending, and Engagement. Commerce is an emerging vertical covering Method’s credit card connectivity, checkout and digital wallet solutions. This role will be the Product lead for Commerce, defining product-market fit and driving execution. You will own the product line end-to-end, operating at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and go-to-market enablement. Success in this vertical is a critical goal of growth for Method, and role is instrumental to achieve that success. This person should have deep expertise in the checkout and payments space, be comfortable operating in ambiguity, and be a proven builder in the fintech domain.

## **What you’ll do**

- Own product strategy for Commerce: define hypotheses, validate them with customers, and decide what to build next.

- Work closely with cross-disciplinary leaders and C-Suite to drive strategy and execution while defining PMF

- Own product discovery with prospective customers and subsequent PRD creation + prototype (Figma, storyboard etc.)

- Conduct user research, market mapping, and competitive landscaping and validate product value through interviews and mock-testing

- Define problem statements, user personas, and success metrics

- Provide RevOps org with required inputs to guide pricing and positioning

- _Support early prospect and expansion conversations as the “voice of product” that guides what we should sell and why._

## **Who you are**

- 8+ years experience as a Product Manager, ideally building and shipping products in the payments or checkout space

- Experience with 0→1 and/or new vertical expansion

- Strong customer-facing discovery skills; you can run structured conversations that produce decision-quality insight.

- Strong business and product judgment, with the ability to operate independently in ambiguous, pre-PMF-stage environments.

- Comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions, CS, and Engineering without direct authority.  
  

## **Extra awesome**

- Proven success at an early stage start-up

- Familiarity with developer-first, API-driven product environments.

- Experience building products from early PMF into growth.

- Demonstrated ability to build enablement and GTM packaging alongside product development.

---

The annual US base salary range for this role is approximately **$180,000 – $240,000** , based on experience and location.

title: Principal Product Manager (AI)
description:
Craniometrix has raised over $21 million to help make dementia suck less.

 

Dementia is tough – but it can be easier. Turns out, if you give families the right non-clinical coaching and support, you can avoid 30% of hospitalizations for these patients. And Medicare has recently started paying for that coaching.

 

We launched our care navigation service for dementia patients in July of 2025, leveraging AI to provide best-in-class care, allowing us to quickly hit $6M of ARR and raise a $15M Series A.

 

Come help us build!

Our care navigators are the heart of our service, connecting regularly with patients and families. Your job is to build the AI frameworks and internal tools that eliminate administrative friction, maximize clinical accuracy, and deepen personalization. By ensuring our AI has the high-fidelity context it needs—and the safety guardrails it requires—you will empower our team to focus 100% of their energy on supporting families.

This is a senior IC role for a builder who sits at the intersection of Operations, Product, and Engineering. You will report to the VP of Operations and be responsible for the internal AI frameworks that power our staff-facing tools.

You aren't just a PM writing specs—you are a systems architect. You will define the logic and safety rules for our internal AI, and then use our AI codex and low-code infrastructure to help build the tools our care navigators and operations managers use every day.

### 

### What You’ll Do

* **Build the Navigator Workbench:**  Design and ship internal AI tools that help our care navigators summarize patient history, deliver more personalized care, flag risks, and automate Medicare-compliant documentation.
* **Optimize the Data Feed:**  You will be a key stakeholder in our data collection process. You’ll provide a critical feedback loop to the team on how we capture data—improving transcript quality, refining form inputs, and optimizing assessment tools to ensure the AI has high-fidelity context.
* **Define the Rules & Frameworks:**  Develop the "logic engine" for our internal AI. You’ll create the prompts, decision trees, and guardrails that ensure our staff receives safe, reliable, and unbiased support.
* **Bridge to Engineering:**  While you will build extensively using our AI codex, you will work closely with the core Engineering team to ensure your internal tools integrate deeply with our data architecture and production stack.
* **Architect the Operational Sandbox:**  Build the underlying frameworks—including data schemas and logic evaluators—that allow non-technical operational leads to contribute to the build process, effectively turning your architectural work into a force multiplier for the entire department.
* **Operational Safety & QA:**  Own the monitoring of AI outputs. You will build the frameworks to audit AI suggestions, ensuring every piece of support provided to our navigators meets our high quality bar.
* **Efficiency Architecture:**  Constantly identify "friction points" in the navigator workflow and build AI-driven solutions to remove them, while managing model costs and latency.

### 

### Who You Are

* **The "Systems" PM:**  You have 5–7+ years of experience in healthcare or high-complexity operations. You think in workflows, edge cases, and feedback loops.
* **Data-Obsessed:**  You understand that "Garbage In = Garbage Out." You are proactive about identifying when a lack of context or poor data quality is hampering AI performance and you know how to fix it at the source.
* **Hands-on AI Builder:**  You have 2+ years of experience building with LLMs. You are skilled in using AI to build and don't need a dev team to move an idea from "concept" to "internal tool."
* **Internal-Tool Obsessed:**  You find joy in building tools that make it easier to deliver care. You care about _utility_ and _safety_ above all else.
* **Pragmatic Engineer-Lite:**  You understand enough about software architecture to partner effectively with engineers, but you prefer the high-velocity environment of building in the Ops layer.

## Compensation

The base pay range for this role is $180,000 – $200,000 per year.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
## **About BoldVoice**

BoldVoice (YC S21) is an AI-powered communication coach that helps non-native English speakers improve their pronunciation, clarity, and confidence. The product combines video lessons from Hollywood accent coaches with instant AI feedback as you speak, powered by our proprietary speech models. The app been downloaded by 4M+ users globally and featured in Forbes, TechCrunch, Wired, and Business Insider.

The company is backed by Y Combinator and other top-tier investors. We’re a small, fast-moving team with a mission to help 1 billion people speak English clearly and advance their careers.

## **The Role**

We’re looking for our **first Product hire** who will own BoldVoice’s product end-to-end. This is not a “write PRDs” role. This is deep ownership of the user experience: what appears in the app, the learning flow, the AI interactions, and the features that move our business.

You’ll report directly to the CEO and work closely with engineering, design, and ML, driving features from insight into the hands of users.

This is an ideal role for a PM (or ex-founder) with 5-8 years of experience who has strong product taste, impeccable UX instincts, and a bias for fast execution. You’ll shape a product that millions interact with, and you’ll ship real user value without layers of process or slow decision cycles.

This role is **fully in-person** in our NoHo office.

## **What You’ll Do**

* Own BoldVoice’s product experience end-to-end across mobile and web
* Identify user problems rapidly and articulate clear, sharp product direction
* Work directly with designer to create intuitive, elegant, consumer-grade UX
* Partner with engineers and ML/speech team to ship impactful features quickly
* Prototype concepts (Figma, quick tools, lightweight user tests) to validate ideas
* Leverage existing analytics (Mixpanel, A/B testing) to find insights and drive decisions
* Roll up your sleeves to unblock progress, whether that’s user interviews, pulling data, writing copy, or spinning up small scrappy tests
* Ensure that AI-powered experiences feel natural, helpful, and user-centric
* Shape onboarding, engagement loops, learning flows, and core product surfaces
* Collaborate with the CEO on long-term product vision while executing quickly day-to-day
* Act as the connective tissue across design, engineering, ML, content, and leadership
* Build features that delight users and directly improve learning outcomes, retention, and growth

## **What You Bring**

* 5–10+ years of product experience OR ex-founder with strong product chops
* A portfolio of shipped features in consumer apps (mobile preferred)
* A deep sense of product taste and UX intuition
* A bias to action: fast, decisive, comfortable shipping and iterating
* Ability to simplify complexity and turn it into intuitive user experiences
* Comfort working closely with engineers, designers, ML teams, and leadership
* Strong analytical instincts; can self-serve insights via Mixpanel + A/B tools
* Humility and willingness to do whatever is needed (user research, quick testing, ops tasks)
* Clear, direct communication and strong ownership mindset
* Ability to run lightweight prototypes or scrappy experiments
* Experience in early-stage startups or building 0→1
* Understanding of LLM/AI product patterns
* Plus: experience in AI apps, consumer subscriptions, or speech/voice AI

## **What Success Looks Like in 3 Months**

* You’ve improved core UX flows with measurable engagement impact
* You’ve become the expert of BoldVoice users and their behaviors
* You’re the person the team relies on to move product from idea → shipped
* The product is materially better because of your taste, iteration speed, and insight

## **Compensation & Perks**

* **Salary:** $150,000–$200,000 depending on experience and seniority
* **Equity:** Own a real piece of BoldVoice’s success
* **A+ Team:** Join a small and mighty team where your work has immediate impact
* **Mission**: Empower millions of immigrants and non-native speakers to speak English with confidence

## **We’d love to hear from you: please [fill out this form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeFCEWWvbz5J-ycq0NQMHf6G_CSNKAnyetSD7nke6J_L0FlYA/viewform?usp=header) to apply.**

### **Position Summary:**

We’re looking for a lightning-fast builder who thinks from first principles and thrives on turning novel ideas into polished, production-ready software. You have the technical depth to architect distributed AI pipelines, the curiosity to experiment with new models and frameworks, and the discipline to ship code that is both reliable and elegant. If you love owning problems end-to-end, moving at high velocity, and measuring success by the real-world health impact of your work, SiPhox may be the right place for you.

### What you will do

* **Design, Build, Ship:** Take full ownership of the product roadmap. You’ll lead the design and implementation of features that scale across our platforms.
* **Collaborate & lead:** Partner with clinical and sales teams to translate product requirements into beautiful, shippable products.
* **Own the Experience:** Ensure every state of every feature is bulletproof. You’ll champion a rigorous testing culture that prioritizes both functional reliability and aesthetic elegance.

### Minimum qualifications

* BS (or equivalent experience) in **Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Cognitive Science, design,** or similar.
* **A Portfolio:** A track record of designing and shipping production-level software where you **owned both the UI/UX and the code.** We want to see products that are as technically sound as they are beautiful.
* **10x Builder:** You are an AI-native developer / vibe-coding power user. You constantly experiment with the latest LLM to ship production-grade code at pace.
* **Product Instinct:** A proven track record of shipping software that isn't just functional, but intuitive. You can translate complex clinical data into a clean, actionable user experience.
* **Communication:** Ability to articulate technical trade-offs to engineers while clearly explaining product decisions to clinical and sales stakeholders.

### How we work

* **Bias for action:** We expect you to prototype in hours, not weeks. If you can ship beautiful, reliable software outrageously quickly, we will give you total autonomy.
* **Extreme Ownership:** You will be responsible for products end-to-end: design → implementation → testing → observability and testing in production. You own the outcome, not just the task.

### Benefits

* Compensation package with stock options and benefits, including high-end gym membership
* Opportunities for professional growth and development
* Work in a dynamic, innovative environment with cutting-edge technology

title: Product Manager
description:
## What Artisan Is

We're building AI employees. Not chatbots. Not copilots. Autonomous digital workers that do real jobs.

Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR used by hundreds of companies. She researches leads, writes and sends emails in a customer's voice, runs multi-step outbound sequences, manages her own deliverability infrastructure, self-optimizes over time, and handles objections and meeting booking. She's not a tool someone uses. She's a teammate.

We're a YC W24 company, have raised $35M+ from investors including Y Combinator, and are at $9M+ ARR. We just launched Ava 2.0, a step change in what an AI employee can do. The engineering problems are hard and the surface area is enormous.

## The Role

The Artisan product has a HUGE surface area. An autonomous AI BDR, a database of 400M+ leads, intent signals, a dialer, enrichments, etc. We replace and automate companies’ entire GTM stacks. This year we’re doubling down on GTM with two new Artisans and massively broadening the scope of the product to enable our users to see more value.

You'll own product areas across the Artisan platform. This is a role where you'll define what we build, drive execution with engineering and design, and be accountable for outcomes and metrics.

**What that looks like concretely:**

* PMs at Artisan do a mixture of product, design and vibe coding. You’ll spend much of your day in Claude, Notion and Figma, owning products from inception through to scale
* You’ll vibe code prototypes for features, get feedback from customers and iterate before handing off to design (or sometimes straight to engineering)
* You pull signal from support tickets, sales conversations, usage data, session recordings, and direct customer feedback. You synthesize all of that into what we build next and what we don't
* You’ll use Claude to write comprehensive PRDs for design and engineering
* You’ll work with design to annotate everything before handing features off to engineering
* You’ll own help center articles, product documentation, adoption and product marketing related to features you build
* We move fast and the backlog is always bigger than the team. You classify work by urgency and impact, manage the sprint, and make hard calls

### Who You Are

* You’re a 10x PM who’s Claude-pilled
* You’re excited to be hands-on with prototyping
* You’re excited to work at Artisan and are happy sometimes working nights and weekends
* You understand APIs, data models, and system architecture well enough to have real conversations with engineers and make informed trade-offs
* You default to data. You're comfortable with product analytics, A/B tests, and using metrics to validate decisions rather than opinions
* High agency and low ego. You don't wait to be told what to do. You identify the highest-leverage problem and go after it
* Comfortable with ambiguity. We're defining new product categories where there's no playbook. You find that exciting, not stressful
* You put the customer and customer outcomes above all else

## Why This Role

You're building the product layer for AI employees. This isn't a standard SaaS platform. Ava makes autonomous decisions, sends real emails to real people, and operates 24/7 on behalf of customers. The product bar is high because when the AI gets it wrong, a real person's reputation is on the line.

The surface area is huge. A lead database of hundreds of millions of people. An AI messaging engine. A multi-channel campaign orchestrator. A CRM. A dialer. An inbox with autonomous reply handling. Intent signals. A billing system. You won't get bored.

You'll define the practice, not just execute it. This is an early-stage product team where you'll shape how we spec, ship, and iterate. Your decisions will set the standard for how the product org operates as we scale.

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We compensate for impact.

## Interview Process

1. Introductory chat with our recruiter
2. 30-minute interview with Jaspar, our CEO
3. Take-home product exercise (real Artisan problem, not busywork)
4. 45-minute product deep dive with Sam, our CPTO
5. 30-minute culture and values interview with Jaspar, our CEO

## Our Culture and Values

* **Founder mindset.** Everyone acts like an owner: take initiative, think big, challenge ideas, and push for 10x outcomes.
* **Obsessed with impact.** We apply the 80/20 rule, kill sunk costs quickly, and focus on what actually moves the needle.
* **Customer-first, always.** Every decision starts with the customer experience.
* **High standards, every detail.** Quality matters in everything we ship, from product and code to copy and design.
* **Clear, direct communication.** We value candor, fast responses, and real feedback.
* **Winning team energy.** Positive vibes, low ego, zero drama. We genuinely enjoy building together.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**_Are you looking for a role in a company that's solving one of the greatest challenges of our lifetime?_**  Ophelia helps people end their opioid use and restore their quality of life with respect for their time and dignity. Our mission is to make evidence-based treatments for opioid use disorder (OUD) accessible to everyone... and we're looking to bring more people onto our team to help us achieve it.

[Ophelia](https://ophelia.com/) is a venture-backed, healthcare startup that helps individuals with OUD by providing FDA-approved medication and clinical care through a telehealth platform. Our approach is discreet, convenient, and affordable. We've been successfully operating in 14 states for almost six years and we're excited to continue our growth. We are a team of physicians, scientists, entrepreneurs, researchers and White House advisors, backed by leading technology and healthcare investors working to re-imagine and re-build OUD treatment in America.

### About The Role

As a **Senior Product Manager** , you will create industry-leading digital products that prove telehealth to be the best way to treat opioid use disorder! You will be shaping our product strategy, aligning stakeholders, and shipping valuable digital products. You will be a leader on one of our product teams and will work cross-functionally with patients, clinicians, operators, marketers, billers, and more (this role is perfect if you want to fully immerse in technology-enabled, healthcare services). Together, you will facilitate collaboration among these stakeholders to identify problems and explore solutions in an iterative way. You will work across the business to solicit great product concepts, collaborate with engineering, product design, and other areas, prioritize work, and communicate effectively to ensure timely and reliable delivery of projects. Ultimately, you will ensure a delightful and people-centered user experience, compliant with industry standards, that meets customer needs and achieves Ophelia’s goals.

To date, we have built a portfolio of bespoke patient and clinical applications, bespoke billing and clinical data services, and commercial integrations, all of which have been core to achieving our goals. Looking forward, our technology roadmap is rich with innovative opportunities across paid-digital, B2B, and peer-led growth, new clinical services, applications of AI for clinicians and Care Coordinators, and a whole lot more. Together, we will build awesome products while we embark towards profitability, our next milestone. 

Our Technology team today is small but mighty and works in close collaboration across software engineering, product design, and data. We use an agile approach rooted in the principles of the Agile Manifesto, with a robust design system well integrated across our team and products. Our product suite includes a custom-built EMR platform for our clinical organization and a patient portal, alongside numerous interaction modes (including text messaging, video conferencing, and third-party software) in our complete product system.

In this fully remote role, you will report to our Chief Technology Officer and be a peer to a Principal Product Manager. Together, we’ll help hard-to-reach people treat their opioid dependence. You may not have experience in this treatment area, but ideally, you’ll have knowledge of the healthcare space, including understanding health outcomes and benchmarks, systems, and regulatory compliance (HIPAA).

**Responsibilities:**

* **Own, develop, and implement a digital product strategy**  for your squad, co-leading a product team along with engineering and product design to deliver value and learn from experiments; we use a triadic leadership model. Translate business goals into product strategy and track associated metrics to determine success.
* **Develop strong relationships**  with stakeholders ranging from executives to individual contributors.
* **Study and share outcomes and learnings.**  Push forward with experiments and use appropriate statistical rigor.
* **Work across the business**  to solicit great product concepts, collaborate with engineering, product design, and other areas, prioritize work, and communicate around the work. Ensure timely and reliable delivery of those projects.
* **Champion and develop the product roadmap** , capturing high level concepts and improvements into the future. Share it broadly.
* **Ensure people-centered focus**  through excellent user experience to meet customer needs through user research, feedback, data, and continuous improvement.
* **Stay current**  with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive innovation and excellence in our digital products. Network frequently beyond Ophelia and share learnings with the team.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* **4+ years experience in product management** ; with a track record of successfully driving stellar business outcomes based on digital product engagement. Demonstrate strong business acumen and strategic thinking to lead product development and grow the business, keep track of key metrics and KPIs, and rigorously prioritize and align the team's work with the company’s wider strategic goals.
* **Stellar communications and stakeholder management**  with a passion for aligning all participants; able to create strong points of view to achieve Ophelia’s strategy, backed with data.
* **Impact orientation**  with focus on delivering outcomes over outputs, choosing to work in a thoughtful, iterative way. You capture learnings, share them broadly, and apply them to future decisions. 
* **Deep understanding of experiment design**  and relevant tools and methods associated with learning through trials, including hypothesis development, statistics, and analysis
* **Familiarity with technical concepts**  and platforms used in full stack web applications with ability to engage productively with engineering and data teams on high-level technical plans, appropriately balance technical sustainability efforts with product work, and handle basic technical questions from users.
* **Robust practitioner of agile manifesto**  including shipping valuable features, focus on live, deep collaboration, highly people-centric, iteration on features and behaviors. Show a love to ship tightly scoped, early iterations, seeking to learn quickly.
* **Culture builder**  with the habit of engendering high psychological safety amongst the team. You are excited about influencing priorities and adapting to new challenges.
* **Passionate about our mission**  to make evidence-based addiction treatment universally accessible. Any experience in healthcare or telehealth is a nice plus!

**Our Benefits Include:**

* Remote work anywhere in the United States 
* Competitive medical, vision, and health insurance (many plans are fully covered for the employee!) 
* Start with 20 days (4 weeks) of PTO, increasing to 5 weeks after 2 years and 6 weeks after 5 years of tenure
* 10 company holidays 
* Work From Home Stipend
* 401k Contribution Platform
* Additional benefits offered through our benefits provider such as life insurance, short and long term disability, financial wellness, virtual primary care, among others!

**Ophelia Compensation Overview**

* We set compensation based on the level and skills required for the role. We value pay transparency and equity, and are committed to fair pay. In order to prevent pay disparities and reduce time spent in negotiations, we take a “first and best” offer approach: this means we’re not holding any compensation back from our candidates, and you can feel confident that our pay is fair and does not vary based on the strength of someone’s negotiation skills.
* Compensation is dynamic at Ophelia: as long as the company performs well and meets our targets, there will be opportunities for increased compensation annually. We’re happy to discuss this approach and our bands if you have questions during the interview process.

Compensation Range

$170,000—$180,000 USD

Interested in learning more about Ophelia and this role? Apply to work with us!

title: Product Manager
description:
## Solo is Closing the Justice Gap

Solo helps people resolve debt. So far, we’ve helped Americans respond to over $2 billion in debt lawsuits, and this is the ground floor. Over 70 million people are in collections every year, and we want to help every one of them.

We’re backed by Kleiner Perkins and Y Combinator, the investors behind Apple, Google, Stripe, and AirBnB.

You can read about us in [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2020/09/15/solosuit-launches-a-web-app-to-to-help-u-s-users-respond-to-debt-lawsuits/), [Business Insider](https://markets.businessinsider.com/news/stocks/legal-assistance-for-the-indebted-public-how-solosuit-assists-americans-in-settling-debt-disputes-1032183138), [Bloom](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/us-law-week/civil-court-fees-block-justice-even-in-well-intentioned-states)[berg, NPR,](https://techcrunch.com/2020/09/15/solosuit-launches-a-web-app-to-to-help-u-s-users-respond-to-debt-lawsuits/) [ABC](https://www.abc4.com/news/local-news/byu-law-students-create-legal-aid-for-debtors/), [IB](https://www.ibtimes.com/solosuit-achieves-milestone-saving-americans-600-million-usd-debt-collection-3673231)[T, and Fast](https://markets.businessinsider.com/news/stocks/legal-assistance-for-the-indebted-public-how-solosuit-assists-americans-in-settling-debt-disputes-1032183138)[Compa](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/us-law-week/civil-court-fees-block-justice-even-in-well-intentioned-states)[ny.](https://www.npr.org/sections/ed/2018/02/24/585374399/a-student-solution-to-give-utah-debtors-a-fighting-chance)

You can learn about our mission and principles [here](https://solosuit.com/careers).

## You’ll define our product.

We’re hiring someone to define and refine our product portfolio.

* Define and refine our product portfolio including SoloSettle, SoloSuit, and Solo AI. 
* Conduct user interviews including user experience interviews, and problem-focused interviews. 
* Review user feedback from many channels including our interview repository, survey response data, customer reviews, and support tickets. 
* Streams tons of user session recordings. 
* Use data to inform intuition and create product hypotheses. 
* Turn product hypotheses into fully scoped engineering tickets. 
* Create Figma designs for product features. 
* Prioritize engineering tickets based prioritization formulas. 
* Scale our product to hundreds of millions in revenue and beyond. 

Solo is fully remote, so this job is fully remote. Salary range $90,000 – $210,000. Bonuses are administered quarterly based on revenue growth. Equity range is 0.001% – 1%.

## You have a background in amazing products.

We’re looking for someone with these qualifications.

* 6+ years of work experience
* Experience as a product manager. Preference is for the experience to have been on a consumer product that had $100m+ in revenue or to have grown significantly from $1m+. 
* Experience at a tech startup that has gone through scale
* Some ability to code
* Desires to move uncomfortably fast
* Works by this principle: do for the customer what you would want done for yourself. 
* Believes excellence is the only authority
* Discovers reality through data analysis and experimentation
* Continuously improves over time

title: Customer Success Manager  / Sr Manager
description:
### **Introduction:**

Ridecell’s vision is to move the world better.  We have a long history of innovation in the mobility and fleet space, from early days running ridesharing, to powering the carsharing platforms for mobility service operators like BMW, Renault, AAA, and Toyota; to more recently expanding into intelligence and automation solutions for large scale fleets with customers like Arval and Merchants.

Ridecell’s Customer Success Manager is a true customer advocate - growing customer relationships from implementation, throughout each lifecycle phase. CSMs serve as the primary liaison between the internal Ridecell team and external stakeholders. They are able to identify, rationalize and communicate customer needs and problems. They are able to empathize, mentor and problem-solve in any circumstance. The ideal candidate is enthusiastic, tech savvy, and passionate about providing an exceptional experience for every customer.

Personal characteristics of individuals who have proven to be a good fit in our dynamic environment include strong strategic thinking skills, an entrepreneurial mindset, the ability to build rapport with customer executives, and a willingness to roll up their sleeves and execute whatever task needs doing.  Candidates with backgrounds in management consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte, Accenture, etc.), operational roles with large fleets or new mobility start-ups (e.g., ridesharing, carsharing), and customer success strategic roles with enterprise solution SaaS vendors often have the skills and experience needed. 

### **Responsibilities:**

**Account Management:**

* **End-to-End Ownership:** Act as the primary lead for the planning, launch, implementation, and long-term refinement of solutions for major enterprise accounts.
* **Executive Partnership:** Develop trusted advisor relationships with day-to-day contacts, middle management, and senior executives in the enterprise accounts.
* **Strategic Reviews:** Drive a consistent cadence of Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) in collaboration with Growth leadership to align on long-term goals.
* **Communication:** Resolve critical customer issues by providing transparent, rapid communication and actionable remedies.

**Project & Program Management:**

* **Priorities and tradeoffs:** Help stakeholders within our customer effectively balance competing priorities and make tradeoffs regarding change requests that align with both the customer’s and Ridecell’s strategies
* **Resource Negotiation:** Balance customer change requests against Ridecell’s internal roadmap; negotiate timelines and workloads to ensure high-performance delivery.
* **Cross-Functional Liaison:** Bridge the gap between customers and internal teams (Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support) to remove project bottlenecks.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Proactively identify and track dependencies; escalate and resolve risks before they impact delivery timelines.

**Solution Execution & Feedback**

* **Training & Enablement:** Conduct product training and demonstrations for customers. Communicate system updates and releases, ensuring client enacts changes based on need and interest
* **Expert Configuration:** Execute complex, urgent, or low-frequency system changes. Rapidly address custom configuration needs to unblock customer growth or operational shifts.
* **Quality Assurance:** Perform hands-on testing of new releases (backend fixes, feature enhancements, and mobile app "smoke testing")
* **Engineering Partnership:** Collaborate directly with Engineering to troubleshoot complex issues, ensuring rapid resolution of mission-critical bugs.

### **Desired Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 5+ years experience working with large enterprises in one or more of the following roles:  B2B account management, solutions delivery, customer success, project management, or program management
* Solid project management skills and experience managing enterprise customer programs and agile cross functional account teams.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented with the ability to prioritize and respond quickly in an ever-changing environment.
* Proven track record of focusing on solutions, key metrics and results, propelled by positive can-do attitude, energy and entrepreneurial spirit to achieve financial success.
* Proven ability to establish productive working relationships at all levels and influence change with internal and external business partners.
* Ability to maintain a good balance of strategic vision and tactical implementation
* Strong verbal, written, presentation and interpersonal skills
* Strong professional ethics and impeccable personal integrity
* Bachelor’s Degree from top university, preferably in technology or business

### **Bonus Qualifications:**

* Experience in managing complex IT projects with an emphasis on integrating disparate internal and external systems
* Good understanding of the fleet management, leasing, logistics, or mobility as a service industries
* Experience in optimizing fleet operations
* MBA or MS

### Compensation:

The posted range reflects base salary + target bonus, and may span multiple career levels. We also include an equity component to total compensation offered. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process based on experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

### **Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging**

Ridecell is not only committed to building our own diverse and inclusive company, we celebrate our differences and actively work with all Ridezillas in achieving their career ambitions in the broader ecosystem. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage all applicants to apply, no matter your race, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, or gender expression. If we can do anything to improve your application and interview process, please let us know!

### **To Recruitment Agencies**

Ridecell does not accept unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Ridecell employees. Ridecell is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

description:
We’re expanding our team and looking for a **Technical Product Manager (TPM)** to drive the strategy and execution for our product strategy at Paragon. We have an incredibly ambitious product vision for 2026 to make Paragon the leading integration infrastructure for AI, and some of our key product initiatives this year include:

* Building the next generation of fully-automated integrations for AI agents
* Creating the best-in-class data ingestion platform for RAG applications
* Making Paragon fully extensible to support any integration
* Building a self-serve product onboarding to make Paragon accessible to all developers

Together, these initiative work towards achieving our mission - **making Paragon the connective layer for all software**.

To help us execute on this vision we need a TPM who can operate at two zoom levels: from a strategic view to drive our roadmap and a tactical, detail-oriented view to deliver the right implementation to customers.

You'll work closely with **engineering, product, sales, and our customers** to ensure we deliver **seamless, scalable, and high-impact products** that power our customers' businesses.

If you love working at the **intersection of product, engineering, and APIs**, thrive in a **fast-paced environment**, and want to shape the future of Paragon’s product vision, we’d love to chat!

[To apply for this role, please use this link to be considered.](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Paragon?utm_source=kP9nEwPW0P)

### **What You’ll Do**

* Build the future of integrations in AI, where APIs are built for agents.
* Define and execute the strategy for Paragon’s growing portfolio of products to meet customer needs and scale efficiently.
* Lead a small team of engineers to evaluate and define technical requirements for new and existing products.
* Collaborate with sales and customer success teams to collect customer requirements and translate them into actionable product roadmap based on impact, feasibility, and market demand
* Lead complex projects end-to-end, including customer research, writing product specifications, and executing with engineering to launch new product features
* Measure impact of new product improvements and iterate based on customer feedback
* Continuously refine our product to improve scalability, performance, and developer experience.

### **You Should Have**

* 5+ total years of experience in **engineering and product management**, including
  * 3+ years of engineering experience, working with APIs, integrations, or developer-focused products.
  * 2+ years as a Technical Product Manager, demonstrating process-driven results in scaling integrations, defining technical product requirements, and leading cross-functional execution.
* A deep understanding of APIs, webhooks, and authentication mechanisms (OAuth, API keys, etc.).
* Experience working closely with engineering teams, defining clear and technically sound product requirements.
* The ability to collect customer requirements and translate technical details into clear product decisions for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading complex, large-scale product launches end-to-end, from writing specs in the design phase, coordinating with engineering on execution, managing launch timelines, and iterating based on customer feedback
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous or complex API challenges.
* A **bias for action**—you don’t just identify problems, you drive solutions.

### **Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience working with **developer tools, API platforms, or integration products**.
* Experience building applications with **SaaS integrations** and understanding of **B2B customer needs**.

title: Product Manager
description:
## About Saturn

Saturn is a Series A, Y Combinator-backed startup building the AI-native operating system for the £100B+ financial advice industry. We believe advice will always be human, and we build technology that makes human advisers extraordinary.

Advisers currently lose up to 70% of their time to administration and compliance. Saturn automates this, giving advisers back their most precious resource so they can focus on what they do best: serving clients. We are compliant by design, trusted by 500+ firms and 3,000+ advisers across the UK.

Our engineers are early and founding team members from Cred, Postman, Gojek, and Slice. We are a small team that orbits together, moves with purpose, and holds a high bar.

## About the Role

We are laser focused on becoming the indispensable operating system for every advice firm. That means understanding what advisers need before they ask for it, shipping the right things fast, and holding a relentless quality bar on every feature advisers use.

As a Product Manager at Saturn, you own one or more product areas end-to-end. You run discovery with financial advisers, decide what gets built, write specs that engineers can execute independently, and ensure every feature ships at the quality bar our enterprise clients expect. You care as much about why we build something as how it works.

You will work closely with Product Engineers who own features end-to-end across frontend, backend, and AI. There is no handoff chain. You define the what and why, they build the whole thing. That means your specs need to be clear, your prioritisation defensible, and your judgment trusted.

Product management at Saturn moves fast. That pace is something we protect deliberately, because we believe the best PMs do their best work when they can see the impact of what they ship.

## What You Will Do

* Own the roadmap for your product area end-to-end. Maintain a rolling 3-6 month view. The next 5 initiatives are clearly defined, the next 5 are shaped, beyond that is directional.
* Run independent discovery with financial advisers and paraplanners. Synthesise conversations into patterns, distinguish signal from noise, and translate adviser pain into product direction.
* Write specs that Product Engineers can build from independently. No ambiguity, no hand-waving. You define the what and why with enough clarity that one engineer ships the whole feature.
* Prioritise ruthlessly across features, bugs, and quality. Say no with clear rationale. Defend your roadmap under pressure.
* Own user acceptance testing personally. You are the voice of the adviser and the last line of defence before a feature reaches users. If it is not ready, it does not ship.
* Ensure sales, CS, and compliance are ready before every release. Treat go-to-market as part of done, not an afterthought.
* Define success metrics and track them yourself. Saturn does not have a data team waiting for your requests. You pull your own analytics and measure outcomes, not outputs.
* Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, and our embedded domain experts (chartered compliance officers and paraplanners) to build AI-powered experiences that are deeply useful.
* You are close to the product, close to the user, and close to the decision. Your instincts shape what Saturn becomes.
* Uphold our principle of being compliant by design: every feature you ship must meet the bar of the UK's principles-based regulatory environment.

## What You Will Need

* 3-5+ years of product management experience at a fast-paced, product-led B2B SaaS company.
* Experience shipping AI-powered products where AI is a core component, not a feature bolted on. You understand the difference between deterministic and probabilistic systems.
* Strong discovery discipline. You do real user research. You have run discovery that changed what got built.
* Sharp prioritisation. You can explain why you said no to something, not just what you said yes to.
* Strong written communication. You produce decision docs and PRDs that reduce meetings rather than create them.
* Technical fluency. You do not hide behind "that's an engineering question." You understand systems well enough to discuss AI architecture trade-offs, know why prompts break, and have productive conversations with engineers.
* Commercial instinct. You connect product decisions to the revenue model and understand what drives retention and expansion in B2B SaaS.
* Self-sufficient with data. You pull your own analytics, define your own metrics, and design experiments without waiting for a data team.

## Our Values

We care deeply about the culture we build. We hire people who are obsessed with doing great work, who seek truth over comfort, who earn trust rather than assume it, and who succeed and fail as one team.

## What We Offer

* Equity / stock options, a genuine stake in Saturn's success.
* On-site in our London office.
* Work on real, hard AI problems at the intersection of fintech, regulation, and LLMs.
* High ownership and fast feedback loops, your work ships and matters from day one.
* A tight-knit, ambitious team that cares deeply about craft, product quality, and each other.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
At [**Domu.ai**](http://Domu.ai), we're building the agentic infrastructure for the future of the world's largest financial institutions. AI agents that handle millions of live interactions every day for Fortune 500 banks and insurers, end-to-end. Interactions are 3x-ing monthly. We're hitting problems most startups never encounter: real-time voice AI at scale, legacy banking infrastructure, enterprise telephony, and building regulatory frameworks in the US.

## **The role**

You will be an essential member of our customer-facing technical team, focused on ensuring an smooth operation and accelerated adoption of our product.

If you’re energized by solving problems and driving tangible results, this is your opportunity to grow, learn with big US clients and be engine that drives customer success and accelerates our growth.

* **Own the Technical Velocity:** You are the crucial link between our innovative platform and our enterprise clients. Your mission is simple: accelerate our customers' time-to-value and ensure their technical journey is seamless, not stressful.
* **The Consistent, Reliable Force:** You'll be the dedicated technical point of contact that our clients trust. By proactively managing communication and technical needs, you directly unblock our senior engineers and keep complex projects moving forward at pace.
* **The Ultimate Owner:** You don't wait for tasks but you identify bottlenecks and proactively clear them. Whether it’s structuring the perfect meeting agenda, translating vague requests into clear tickets, or relentlessly chasing a solution, you thrive on driving things to completion.

## **How we work**

We are deeply committed to your professional development. You will be given immediate opportunities to take ownership and the mentorship needed to grow quickly into a senior, high-impact technical leader.

We're a team built to win in a seriously competitive market and our growth is insane. That means we're constantly running into problems most startups never even dream of seeing. To do that, we need a level of focus, speed, and real craftsmanship that's just not the normal.

Every single person here feels like this is the absolute best thing they could be doing right now. This isn't about working for the sake of working, it's about being competitive and genuinely loving the challenge.

Because of this, you'll see us hanging out a lot in the office. **We enjoy the work, we love winning, and we like being around each other.** Expect to join in on team stuff like gym sessions, runs, dinner/lunch, and Xbox breaks.

## **Why Domu**

1. Small team, high leverage. Your work ships immediately.
2. Real traction. Post-revenue, Fortune 500 customers, 3x monthly growth.
3. Unsolved problems. Real-time voice AI in regulated industries, at scale.
4. We care about doing great work and that's the expectation for each one of us.

## **What we offer**

1. Healthcare
2. weekly stipend for food and transportation
3. gym membership
4. equipment budget
5. whatever tools you need

title: (Senior) Solution Engineer
description:
## **About Finto**

Finto is on a mission to reinvent how enterprises run their finance operations. Starting with **AI-powered automation for accounts payable,** we eliminate manual invoice handling, supplier chasing, 3-Way-Matching and ERP data entry. Backed by Y Combinator, we’re building the future of enterprise accounting.

Our mission is to free the world’s finance teams from repetitive, low-value tasks so they can focus on impactful work. That starts with building a place where everyone can do their best work. Whether you’re building on our platform, partnering with our customers, or shaping our story: We just make things finance teams want.

## **About the role**

We’re looking for a (**Senior) Solution Engineer** to join our founding team and lead the adoption of Finto’s AI-powered automation for some of the world’s largest enterprises. You’ll be the trusted partner guiding finance teams through onboarding, integration, and - most importantly - putting AI directly into their hands so they can radically reduce manual work and unlock new levels of productivity.

This is more than a traditional CS role - you’ll combine strategic account management with hands-on enablement, workflow design, and change management. You’ll work closely with our founders to make sure customers embrace AI as a core part of their daily job.

We’re headquartered in Munich, with roots in San Francisco through Y Combinator.

## **What you’ll do**

* Lead enterprise customers from onboarding to full-scale adoption
* Work directly with finance teams to redesign key processes, embedding AI where it delivers the most value.
* Partner with customers to deeply understand their ERP setup, accounting workflows, and success metrics.
* Train and enable end users so AI-powered automation becomes part of their daily toolkit.
* Act as the bridge between customers and our product/engineering team - championing feedback, surfacing unmet needs, and influencing roadmap.
* Build playbooks, training materials, and onboarding processes to built customer success.

## **What we’re looking for**

* 2-3+ years in customer success, account management, consulting, or implementation with enterprise SaaS customers.
* Experience driving adoption of complex software, ideally AI-powered or automation platforms.
* Familiarity with finance operations, ERP systems, or accounting workflows is a strong plus.
* Exceptional communication skills - able to train, inspire, and win over buyers, key users and IT leaders.
* Proven ability to lead change management initiatives and help teams adopt new ways of working.
* Hands-on problem-solver with a proactive, can-do approach.
* Thrives in fast-paced, early-stage environments with high autonomy.
* Passion for making AI a practical, everyday tool for real people.

## **Life at Finto**

* Career-defining growth: Big ambitions mean rapid progression, expanding responsibilities, and access to our San Francisco & YC network.
* Competitive pay & meaningful equity: Share in the upside of a YC-backed, fast-scaling company.
* 25 vacation days + 2 fixed “company recharge days.”
* Twice-yearly team offsites and hacker weeks in Europe or San Francisco.

5. Offer

title: Customer Solutions Engineer
description:
Axle is the insurance communication infrastructure for the age of AI. We make it easy for brands like Hertz, Avis, 1,200+ dealerships, Fortune 500 lenders, and their AI agents to securely connect to their users' insurance data in seconds.

The multi-trillion dollar insurance industry still relies on phone calls, paper forms, and outdated systems that are slow, error-prone, and easy to fake.

That's where Axle comes in. We bridge the gap between insurance and other industries through a universal API for insurance data, enabling our clients to make business decisions in seconds instead of hours while allowing consumers to unlock their most underutilized financial asset - insurance.

We are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Google's AI fund Gradient Ventures, and angels from companies like Plaid and Cox Automotive.

Our team is in-person 4 days a week in our Flatiron/NoMad office in NYC.

For more details, check us out at [**https://axle.insure**](https://axle.insure).

## About the Role

As a Solutions Engineer at Axle, you'll play a pivotal role bridging technical solutions and customer success throughout the entire customer journey, from first conversation through full adoption. You'll collaborate closely with the Sales, Engineering, and Product teams to design and implement tailored solutions, from initial discovery and demos to integration, onboarding, and ongoing support. Your work will directly impact customer satisfaction, adoption, and Axle's growth trajectory.

We’re looking for individuals who think creatively about problems, push for real-world customer impact, keep up to date on the latest in AI and GTM engineering, and are excited about helping financial data reach full connectivity.

### **Why you should consider joining**

* Trusted by leading Fortune 500 banks and top brands like Hertz, Avis, and Sixt - with more joining every month.
* Grown revenue 5x this year to 7-figures ARR, with growth continuing to accelerate.
* Backed by world-class investors including Google (Gradient Ventures), Y Combinator, and leaders from Plaid and Cox Automotive.
* Join a tight-knit team where everyone drives real impact we have top-tier customer and revenue metrics with half the team size of typical startups.
* Work on challenging, unsolved problems at the intersection of complex data structuring, agentic workflows, and financial risk analysis.
* We care deeply about our team and provide great compensation and equity, full benefits, unlimited time-off, and plan an annual team offsite!

We're a lean team, and our customer base is growing too fast for us to keep up. We're looking for talented team members to join our early team ahead of our next round and execute on an ambitious roadmap.

### What You’ll Do

* Own the overall relationship with clients: identify key stakeholders, build relationships with influencers and core teams, and develop expertise in clients’ technology, processes, and how they integrate Axle.
* Proactively project manage Axle’s role in enterprise implementations, coordinating stakeholders, managing timelines, and tracking deliverables with Fortune 500 companies and partners.
* Oversee customer onboarding and configuration; act as the primary point of contact post-sales, nurturing relationships and providing world-class support.
* Travel approximately once per month to meet with customers and partners, reinforcing relationships and ensuring successful implementations.
* Participate in design sessions with clients to deeply understand their needs, design how Axle will fit into their product and workflow, and define the people, process, and technology required to bring client solutions to life.
* Act as the voice of the customer by gathering, analyzing, and synthesizing insights to influence and prioritize product enhancements.
* Maintain and expand our knowledge base, API documentation, and other solutions resources.
* Help lay the foundation for the Solutions organization, growing into a trusted technical advisor who provides consultative guidance on Axle and industry best practices as clients build and scale their applications.

### What We’re Looking For

* 5+ years of experience in Technology Consulting, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or other customer-facing engineering roles.
* Elite project management skills and proven ability to lead complex customer implementations, driving projects to completion while keeping stakeholders and internal teams aligned.
* Strong customer-facing presence, even when working with challenging stakeholders.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.
* Strong problem-solving skills and creative thinking.
* An insatiable curiosity — always asking _why_ and eager to dig deep into how things work.
* Ability to quickly understand a new business, industry, or process and get up to speed fast.
* A humble attitude and willingness to dive into the weeds.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, cloud services, and modern architectures.
* Self-motivated, adaptable, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.

### What would be even better?

* Working knowledge of node/javascript, the ability to build your own tools and/or query data using SQL.
* Previous experience in insurance, fintech, or related industries
* A strong background in fintech and/or API services.

title: Product Manager / General Manager (Principal)
description:
### Role Summary

**Gym Class** is a top-rated social game on Meta Quest - millions of downloads, 79,000+ reviews, 4.9★. We’re backed by top technology and sports investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Y Combinator, the NBA, the Golden State Warriors, and athlete-investors like Kevin Durant, Andre Iguodala, Lonzo Ball, Danny Green, Zaza Pachulia, and others.

We’re building a social gaming platform - where games, identity, community, and content come together to create daily reasons to return. This year we’re scaling VR, expanding the platform to mobile, and evolving our flagship basketball experience into a full live-service game.

We’re hiring a **Principal Product Leader → GM** who will start by shipping the highest-leverage product changes that move retention and revenue (**onboarding, live ops, and a deeper meta-game like Career Mode**), then turn what works into **repeatable systems** as we expand the platform and add new games. As the platform grows, your scope grows: from owning the flagship experience end-to-end (**activation → retention → monetization → live ops**) to incubating the next breakout games and helping shape the broader **mobile + UGC** roadmap. You’ll ship with a world-class team, to a highly engaged audience with an immediate feedback loop, and deliver company-level impact.

### WHAT YOU’LL DO

* **Own flagship outcomes end-to-end:** Be accountable for **activation → retention → monetization → live ops**. Find the biggest bottlenecks, set the plan, align the team, and deliver.
* **Turn “fun” into “full game”:** Package the flagship into a complete live-service experience - tighter onboarding, clearer goals, deeper progression, stronger reasons to return daily/weekly.
* **Ship a deeper meta-game (Career Mode):** Launch a singleplayer Career Mode that creates long-term pull - progression, bot gameplay, milestones, rewards, narrative framing - and connect it to the broader platform (identity/status, seasons, unlocks).
* **Build the Live Ops engine:** Create and run the cadence: seasons, events, challenges, drops, experiments. Ship weekly iterations and drive measurable lifts in D7/D30, depth, and spend.
* **Strengthen social loops:** Improve the social fabric (parties/squads, competitive ladders, leaderboards/tournaments, spectating, community moments) so the game feels like a world, not a match.
* **Run the product like a business:** Make tradeoffs with ROI awareness. Prioritize what moves the metrics; cut what doesn’t. Set standards for quality, pacing, and reliability.
* **Create repeatable systems as you scale:** Turn wins into process that compounds - dashboards, rituals, operating cadence, quality bars, and launch playbooks the whole platform can reuse.
* **Expand scope into more games:** Once the flagship is on a strong trajectory, your scope will expand to additional games on the platform.
* **Cross-pollinate across mobile + AI + UGC:** Advise and influence mobile + AI + UGC efforts with proven retention/monetization/live ops patterns - and as bandwidth opens, take direct ownership where you can create step-function impact.

### QUALIFICATIONS — you are…

* **A product shipper (not a committee):** You don’t wait for perfect specs - you define problems, make calls, and ship high-quality work fast.
* **Live-service fluent:** You’ve built/operated products with ongoing updates - events, economies, progression, battle passes, ranked seasons, experimentation, and iteration tied to outcomes.
* **Metrics-native:** Comfortable owning and improving funnels/cohorts (D1/D7/D30, conversion, ARPDAU/ARPU, LTV) and using data + player feedback together.
* **Great taste + systems thinking:** You can craft experiences players love, then operationalize them into durable systems that scale across teams and titles.
* **Cross-functional leader:** You can drive alignment across design, engineering, art, analytics, community, and marketing — and keep execution moving without heavy process.
* **Startup builder energy:** You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, raise the bar, and treat the product like it’s yours. Ex-founders very welcome.

### Nice to have

* Shipped/owned live service games, progression systems, economies, competitive ladders, or social platform mechanics.
* Experience with social games, UGC ecosystems, products for younger demographics. VR experience is NOT required.
* Sports game intuition or deep familiarity with competitive multiplayer communities.

### Pay and Benefits

Salary ranges may be inclusive of several career levels and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Additional benefits for this role include: equity; and medical, dental, and vision benefits; and 401k retirement plan with matching.

title: Founding AI Product Manager
description:
**About Soff**

Soff is the AI agent workforce for the physical world. We bridge the gap between data intelligence and industrial execution. By deploying a specialized workforce of AI agents orchestrated by a central intelligence, we give enterprises the power to automate mission-critical tasks with absolute precision.

Starting with Sales.

Soff evolves with every transaction, turning operational friction into a competitive edge so sales teams stop firefighting and start growing the company.

**About the Role**

You will join as our **Founding AI Product Manager**. You'll work closely with the founder, engineers, and customers to define what Soff builds and why. You'll own the product end-to-end — from how our AI agents process RFQs and match part numbers to how quotes flow back through legacy ERP systems. You'll be the connective tissue between deep customer workflows and engineering execution.

**What you'll do**

* Own the product roadmap for Soff's AI agents — autonomous context-aware conversation, part matching, quote generation, and ERP sync
* Work directly with industrial customers to deeply understand their operations, then translate that into clear product bets
* Define how our AI agents handle edge cases, exceptions, and multi-step workflows — and design feedback loops that make the system smarter over time
* Set prioritization and sequencing across customer requests, technical debt, and new capabilities to maximize impact
* Own the ERP integration roadmap — decide which systems to support next and work with engineering to build repeatable integration patterns
* Partner with engineering on LLM pipeline decisions, part number matching accuracy, and agentic email processing reliability
* Ship. Constantly. We're a small team and you'll have enormous leverage on what gets built

**What we want**

* **Anything it takes mentality.** Together, we do what it takes to win customers and build the right product.
* **Builder, not bureaucrat.** You've shipped real products, ideally from scratch. Founder experience or first-PM-at-a-startup experience is a strong plus.
* **Technically fluent.** You're not writing production code, but you can read it, reason about LLM pipeline tradeoffs, and hold your own in architecture discussions. Technical degree or equivalent strongly preferred.
* **Domain-curious.** You're excited — not intimidated — by learning ERP systems, fastener encoding schemes, and B2B distribution workflows. You find unglamorous industries fascinating when there's a massive problem to solve.
* **Sweats the details.** Product quality in our space means getting part numbers right, handling ERP edge cases, and never dropping a customer's order. You care about the last 5%.
* **Thrives in ambiguity.** We're a startup. Many things change, pretty dramatically, very quickly. You find that energizing.
* **Excellent communicator.** You can talk to a family-owned fastener distributor in the morning and whiteboard system architecture with engineers in the afternoon.

**Why Join Soff?**

* We're growing massively and are backed by Silicon Valley's best investors (Y Combinator, General Catalyst, etc.)
* **Ownership & Autonomy** — You're the founding PM. You'll shape the product org from the ground up.
* **Real Impact** — Industrial distribution is a $6T+ market running on phone calls and manual data entry. Your work transforms how real businesses operate.
* **Top-Tier Compensation** — Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.
* **Comprehensive Benefits** — Healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
* **Work With the Best** — Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

If you've read until here, send a note with your favorite song 😊

HeyCharge is an early-stage, VC-backed Munich, Germany-based startup specializing in ultra-low-cost, scalable electric car charging solutions for indoor environments like apartment building parking garages, offices, and more. We recently graduated from Y Combinator's Summer 2021 batch.

As our product roadmap and feature design grows more complex, we seek a visionary and capable technical product manager to bring improved depth and quality of execution to each product and feature.
