title: Technical Product Manager, Software
description:
Mason is the only fully managed infrastructure for developing and delivering dedicated devices. We make it easy for anyone to turn an idea into a smart product and ship it to anywhere in the world. Our mission is to enable our customers to create smart and sustainable products on behalf of humanity.

We're looking for the right person to join our close-knit team and help take our foundational product and business to the next level. Mason's core product is mobile infrastructure as a service ("mobile IaaS") — think elastic, customizable hardware + software + services. Mason is used across industries and use cases today, from digitizing clinical trials, to improving warehouse efficiency, streamlining retail payments, and more.  

 

As a part of our Product Team, you will quite literally define what the future of Mason’s products look like. We're looking for the right person to join our close-knit team and own our core platform services, fleet management tools, and developer tools. 

 

This role is for a Technical Product Manager with a technical software background who thrives on building zero-to-one products, scaling platform services, and deeply understanding their customers’ needs. 

 

Mason is looking for a complex combination of grit, smarts, ingenuity, and diverse perspectives (and more!). [Check out our values](https://bymason.com/about/) and see if they resonate! 

### What you’ll work on:

- Define and drive the strategic roadmap for Mason’s core Controller product including developer-facing APIs, tooling, and SDKs
- Drive execution and experimentation of product releases, including setting goals and metrics for success
- Deliver product requirements and specs, in partnership with design, engineering, marketing, and customer success
- Develop key relationships with customers and gain insight on customer needs, validating product direction
- Represent the Mason team and product in external forums and industry events
- Deploy, use and test your own product to accept and provide early feedback within the development lifecycle

### What you bring to the table:

- BA/BS in Computer Science, a related field of study or equivalent experience
- 5+ years of product manager experience (ideally with a focus on cloud infrastructure products)
- Strong understanding of the Cloud Infrastructure and the market: AWS, Azure, GCP, etc
- Excellent communication, both written and verbal
- Technical understanding in one or more of: containerization, continuous deployment, operating systems, micro-services, Android applications, distributed systems
- Proven track record of shipping successful enterprise software products
- Data-driven decision maker
- Detail-oriented and passionate about a great user experience combined with the ability to back proposed decisions by data

**Bonus Points for:**

- Experience as a software engineer or equivalent technical expertise, with a focus on cloud infrastructure products
- Experience in a fast-paced startup environment

 

**Salary Range: 115,000 - 165,000 USD** 

 

In addition to the base salary, full-time employees are eligible for participation in Mason’s annual discretionary bonus plan and equity plan, subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay based on exemption status. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate including their skills, experience level, qualifications, location, and other job-related reasons.

 

We know that benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. To learn more about what’s included in total compensation, check out some of the benefits and perks Mason offers to help employees grow.

**Benefits and Perks:**

- **Remote-forward:** Employees may choose to work fully remote, in-office, or hybrid.
- **Generous PTO:** Flexible PTO plan or generous accrued PTO, plus monthly mental health days during the pandemic.
- **Parental Leave:** Caring for a new child is an exciting time for parents! We offer 16 weeks of paid parental leave.
- **Healthcare:** Fully paid premiums of medical, dental & vision insurance for you, your spouse & dependents. Coverage starts 1st of the month, on or after hire.
- **Fitness & Wellness:** Quarterly reimbursement for qualified fitness & wellness expenses.
- **Retirement:** Tax-advantaged 401k account to help you reach your retirement goals.
- **FSA:** Healthcare, Dependent Care & Commuter FSAs for tax-advantaged savings toward eligible expenses.
- **Home Office:** Spot bonus & monthly stipend for qualified home office expenses.
- **Commuter/Food:** Monthly bonus to supplement commuter & food costs.

_Full benefits are offered to regular full-time employees. Part-time employees participate on a limited basis._

* * *

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Mason**

Belonging, psychological safety, and inclusivity unlock a Mason’s full potential. We don’t want Masons to quietly assimilate into a dominant culture and sacrifice a piece of themselves. We want our team members to be seen, validated, and welcomed. 

 

Mason America, Inc. (the “Company”) is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

 

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on the Company. Please inform the Company’s personnel representative if you need assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application process.

title: Technical Product Lead
description:
Hi 👋 I'm [Arne](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arne-gebert/), Co-Founder and CPO at Kombo.

I'm looking to hire a Technical Product Lead who will report directly to me, and own our new Learning vertical. \_ **Your challenge is to lead the vertical from the first customers and strong signs of product-market fit to 1M+ ARR in Revenue this year, acting like a founder within a startup.** \_

I believe that the best products get shipped by small, autonomous teams acting with a lot of ownership and leeway (like an early-stage startup or similar to [PostHog](https://posthog.com/handbook/company/small-teams), [OpenAI](https://calv.info/openai-reflections), [Revolut](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/sytaylor_revolut-goes-hard-they-have-up-to-20-products-activity-7269709386896347137-uz8V/)) with product-minded engineers acting, owning much more of the product lifecycle than typical. This means our PMs can focus on strategy, prioritization, ensuring we build the right things for our customers and overall much more acting like a GM or founder of the product.

**After 12–24 months in this role, you will have led a full 0 → 1 → scale journey with direct revenue ownership and gain the kind of experience that is a strong launchpad for future founder, CPO, or GM roles.**

If this sounds like the kind of opportunity and challenge that excites you, I'd love to hear from you.

# 📱 About Kombo

Kombo is building the unified API for ATS, HR, and payroll systems. Instead of companies spending months integrating with dozens of different systems, they can integrate once with Kombo and instantly connect to over 90 platforms. We abstract away the complexity of handling different data schemas, authentication methods, and API quirks.

### **Since going through Y Combinator in 2022, we:**

* Grew from zero revenue to 8+ millions in ARR and hundreds of customers at a pace that puts among [the \~top-5% of VC-backed startups](https://chartmogul.com/reports/saas-growth-vc-bootstrapped/)
* Scaled to process data for the equivalent of 20% of Germany's workforce
* Raised $30M+ of funding from Y Combinator, 468 Capital and other top-tier investors
* Grew to a team of 55+ working across Berlin and NYC

# 👀 The Opportunity

We launched the new Learning vertical in December and we have experienced an overwhelming positive response (i.e., **we went from 0 to 100k ARR in one month)** despite limited capacity on the engineering side.

This was the **most successful launch** we had at Kombo so far and we believe it’s feasible to unlock millions of revenue ( **=10-20x current revenue** ) and deliver a significantly better learning experience to hundreds of thousands of employees this year alone.

However, the vertical currently has no long-term product owner making **product capacity the limiting factor for scaling the vertical.**

This is where you come in.

# 🦉 Your Role

As our Learning Product Lead, **you'll own the entire LMS integration vertical end-to-end** - from strategy to execution. This is a founding PM role with high visibility and direct impact on company growth.

### **Your core responsibilities:**

* **Own the Learning vertical strategy** : Chart the product roadmap and strategy for all Learning use cases using our API, working closely with our product engineers and prioritising the initiatives we could run
* **Manage all the chaos in a growing vertical:** juggle different sales requests, new customer use cases, integration timelines etc. → bring structure into these demands, especially where it’s not a differentiated use of engineering time
* **Become the market expert and drive customer understanding** : Attend conferences, run customer interviews, and educate the entire company about recruiting use cases using our API. Ideally, you are as knowledgeable about our customers (e.g., [Blinkist](https://www.blinkist.com/), [Panopto](https://www.panopto.com/)) and their requirements as a PM working at our customer.
* **Enable the sales and success team:** Sometimes, you will do ‘founder-led sales’ - you will jump on a sales call for an important prospect or answer prospect questions (as you will overall be the market expert)
* **Coach and guide engineers during initiatives** : Serve as product stakeholder during initiatives, ask ‘stupid questions’ “why can’t we do X?” and coach engineers if they go off-track

### **Recent projects you would have owned:**

* **Act as product stakeholder for a bulk course creation initiative:** Help the team understand the customer needs for a new endpoint and collaborate to scope out a solution that meets these needs while minimising engineering effort
* **Representing Kombo at** [**Learning Technologies France**](https://www.learningtechnologiesfrance.com/en) **(Paris):** Attend a major industry conference, speak with 20+ customers and prospects over two days to deepen market understanding, validate product direction, and reinforce Kombo’s credibility in ongoing deals.
* **Help closing and onboarding** [**Blinkist**](https://www.blinkist.com/) **:** Play a central role in closing Blinkist as one of our first (and most demanding) customers, understanding what new product functionality they need, and judging what we can commit to by when (and for what commercial terms)
* **Evaluating an eLearning integration standard:** Partner with an engineer to analyze the (competing) [SCORM](https://scorm.com/) standard in depth, assessing its technical complexity, market relevance, and strategic fit to inform whether and how it should influence our product roadmap.

**Ultimately, you are responsible for picking the right priorities and ensuring excellent execution across both product quality and velocity.**

# 🦄 About You

For this role, past or aspiring founders are likely ideal - but we're excited to evaluate candidates from other backgrounds as well.

## Descriptions that match you:

### **⚕ Strong technical understanding**

* You used to be an engineer or worked very closely together with engineers in the past (e.g., PM for a Platform team). Alternatively, you have strong curiosity about getting more technical but at the minimum you should know how an API works and, e.g., be able to easily read [API documentation](https://docs.kombo.dev/introduction).
* Since we have a technical product, this baseline understanding highly correlates with product taste and intuition, and overall good judgement, in our domain.

### **🚀 Agency and ownership**

* You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You naturally act like an owner, push things forward without being asked, and are comfortable making decisions under uncertainty.
* You are entrepreneurially-minded and have been a founder in the past or are seriously considering doing so in the future.

### **🗺️** [**You operate across levels of abstraction**](https://www.brex.com/journal/operate-at-all-levels)

* You know when to think in terms of strategy, revenue, and positioning - and when to go deep into details (e.g. understanding a learning standard or edge-case integration) to unblock progress.

### **🗣️ Business and customer curiosity**

* You care about how the product drives revenue and adoption. You enjoy direct customer interaction, join sales calls when needed, attend conferences, and build first-hand understanding of market needs.

# What It's Like To Work at Kombo

Our culture is built around two pillars: high ambition (and thus high-performance) while still providing [a fun and supportive environment](https://www.notion.so/Join-Kombo-05435d42f09a4b85b2083ae2266543af?pvs=21).

Some tidbits that illustrate this:

* Our growth puts us into the \~top-5% of VC companies and we have the ambition to keep this pace
* We aspire to create an environment of few but very high-performing team members (similar to [Ashby](https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/ashbys-operating-principles) or [Netflix](https://jobs.netflix.com/culture))
* Even though we are in-office, we have a strong writing culture and [use long-form documents to make important (one-way) decisions](https://tim.blog/2023/09/21/sam-corcos-transcript/) because we believe we make better decisions this way
* On average, we get together for [a company-wide celebration](https://www.notion.so/Join-Kombo-05435d42f09a4b85b2083ae2266543af?pvs=21) \~once a week (larger feature release, big new closing, anniversary or birthday!)
* We have a well-established Meme culture: \[pls-check-on-Ashby-to-see-images-WaaS-doesn’t-support-them\]

# Closing

This is a rare opportunity to take a product that has already proven traction from 0 → 1 and the kind of experience you usually only get if you are a startup founder and hit the pivot-hell-lottery.

If this sounds appealing to you, please apply! even if you don't match all criteria 🙂

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
## **About Blue Onion**

Blue Onion is modernizing the CFO stack. We help finance teams automate reconciliation, understand their data at a transactional level, and close the books faster with a modern, AI-first platform.

## **About This Role**

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who will lead end-to-end product strategy, roadmapping, and driven execution for some of our most impactful product offerings. You will bring innovation to the eCommerce accounting space through deep understanding of our users (CFOs and accountants) needs by building on top of our AI driven data platform. This role is highly cross-functional and foundational so you will partner with engineering, customer support, and GTM to iteratively and measurably build invaluable products and features for your users. 

## **What You’ll Do** 

* Own the strategy and roadmap for critical product areas, from data normalization and reconciliation workflows to reporting and insights
* Drive execution with engineering by defining, scoping, and delivering high-impact work with urgency, clarity, and technical depth
* Deeply understand user needs through direct conversations, workflow mapping, and usage analytics to shape prioritization and design
* Craft compelling narratives with crisp product requirements, user stories, and documentation that align teams and accelerate decision-making
* Measure what matters, monitor adoption and outcomes, and iterate quickly to ensure we are driving real value for customers
* Balance short- and long-term bets, solving foundational problems while shipping iteratively to learn and deliver early value
* Think in systems, not isolated features, designing for extensibility, data integrity, and future scale
* Collaborate closely across teams including Engineering, Support, Sales, and Success to ensure a seamless end-to-end customer experience

## **Required Skills & Experience**

* You have 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in SaaS, fintech, or data-heavy B2B platforms
* You have founder (or early stage startup) experience and have a proven track record of ruthless prioritization for the customer’s best interest
* You’ve owned a roadmap before and can back up your prioritization with a strong point of view
* You’re technical enough to talk APIs, data models, and systems design with engineers and always pushing for exceptional execution
* You’re comfortable in ambiguity and see it as a chance to carve out clarity
* You can toggle between strategy and detail without losing the thread
* You write and communicate clearly, concisely, and often
* Bonus: you’ve worked data infrastructure, or with accounting systems

## **Why Blue Onion**

We’re a startup with real traction, real revenue, and a strong point of view about where financial infrastructure is going. We’re still early, so you’ll have the chance to leave a lasting mark on our product, culture, and trajectory. You’ll work directly with the founders and build foundational things that _actually matter_.

## **Compensation & Benefits**

* Base Salary of $150,000 – $175,000
* Remote-first team with flexible hours
* Comprehensive benefits package, including 401(k), health, dental, and vision insurance
* Unlimited PTO, paid parental leave, and paid holidays

title: Founding DevRel
description:
Mendral is The AI DevOps Engineer. Three always-on agents handle security, reliability, and performance, plus custom automations for anything else specific to your stack. From the team behind Docker and Dagger (YC W19).

We run in production at PostHog, Metabase, Luminai, Inngest, Clipboard Health, Blaxel, among others. Across millions of CI jobs, 73% of failures auto-match to known issues. PostHog accepted 104 fixes from Mendral in a single month.

### The Role

We're looking for an engineer who writes. Someone who can sit in our codebase, understand how the agents work, and publish the kind of technical posts that other engineers actually read and share. We're not hiring a marketer. We're hiring an engineer whose job is to make other engineers smarter about CI, agents, and DevOps. Pipeline follows from great content. We're not asking you to measure it, build funnels around it, or chase attribution.

### What you'll work on

* Technical blog posts that earn the front page of HN. Examples we've shipped: "We gave terabytes of CI logs to an LLM" (226 points), "What CI Actually Looks Like at a 100-Person Team," "Anatomy of a Production AI Agent."
* Conference talks. DevOpsDays, KubeCon, AI engineering events, anywhere senior engineers go to hear from peers.
* Meetups. Attending, speaking, hanging out with practitioners and bringing back what they're actually struggling with.
* Open-source contributions and code samples. Small, sharp repos that demonstrate ideas from our posts.
* Product demos. Recorded for the site, live for engineering teams who want a deeper look at the system.
* Customer engineering deep-dives. Working with teams at PostHog, Metabase, and others to write about real implementations at scale.
* Community presence on HN, Reddit, and X. Engaging engineer-to-engineer, not broadcasting.

### What we're looking for

* **Engineering background.** You've written code in production. You can read a CI log, reason about a flaky test, and write about it without translation help from us.
* **Strong technical writer.** You have public examples we can read. Blog posts, RFCs, postmortems, OSS docs.
* **Speaker or aspiring speaker.** You've given talks before, or you want to. Comfortable on camera and on stage without three weeks of prep.
* **Curious about the stack.** You find agent architecture, CI internals, and infrastructure interesting on their own terms, not as marketing surface.
* **High agency.** You're the first hire in this seat. Nobody is briefing you. You're the brief.

### Why now

Seed-funded with named customers shipping fixes from Mendral every day. Founders who built Docker and Dagger and write engineer-first content themselves. We've already had multiple HN front-page posts. Your job is to make that the norm, not the exception. You'll be one of the first full-time hires, and the equity reflects that.

Based in the SF Bay Area is preferred, or remote in a compatible timezone.

title: Legal Product Specialist (UK)
description:
As a Legal Product Specialist you will be the internal voice-of-the-customer at DraftWise. You will work closely with our Product, Design and Engineering teams in the development and testing of new features and you will help shape our understanding of drafting, negotiation and review workflows for lawyers. You will also help communicate the value of our product to new users and customers.

In order to succeed in this role, you will need to be an excellent communicator, capable of understanding technical concepts and translating complex legal concepts into terms non-lawyers can interpret.

Your day-to-day work will be a mix of:

* Keeping up-to-date with fast moving AI and legal industry trends
* Identifying truly useful applications of LLMs to the legal industry based off of your own knowledge and through interviews with other legal professionals
* Working closely with the Product team to define the vision for new DraftWise applications
* Testing new DraftWise applications and providing detailed feedback to the Design and Engineering teams
* Validating the output of generative AI models and providing labeled data to assist with the fine-tuning of such models
* Joining user and sales calls to help communicate the value of DraftWise to fellow legal professionals

We are a small team and expect all members to flexibly help wherever the company needs them the most - if you have an idea for what DraftWise needs, we want to empower you to pursue that project. You will have broad ownership over your initiatives, the ability to shape our culture as we grow and flexibility over your schedule..

## What we value

* Strong communication skills in an open environment.
* Creating an environment of trust through well-intentioned feedback.
* Skills to work independently and make decisions with minimal supervision.
* Interest in working in a dynamic environment with dynamic objectives.

## About You

* 5-8 years experience practicing as a transactional lawyer in Big Law
* Experience drafting, negotiating and reviews legal agreements
* Outstanding communication skills and a flair for breaking complex legal concepts down into terms non-lawyers can understand
* Basic understanding of software and technical products and an eagerness to learn more about product development and the application of AI in the legal industry
* Passion for building a product to help legal professionals
* Technical experience as a software engineer or similar role is a nice-to-have
* In-house experience is a nice-to-have

## What we offer

* All-remote work style, work anywhere. Ideally within UTC+4 to UTC-7
* Equity plan
* Competitive salary
* Private medical care
* New laptop and a work-from-home stipend for necessary accessories
* Generous PTO / sick leave
* Opportunity to lead our company as we disrupt the legal world
interview_process:
* Intro chat to share with you what we are building and to learn more about your interests and experience. We are searching for enthusiasm, ownership and autonomy. (30 mins)
* Case study where you will be presented with an early access preview of a feature we are developing and we will discuss the application of this feature to your work as a practicing lawyer (45 mins)
* Take-home project to validate the output of a DraftWise product and provide your detailed feedback on the application of that product to your work as a practicing lawyer (<2 hours)

title: Product Manager
description:
Come work with us to find and empower talent across the U.S., while solving the biggest problem facing businesses today. We‘re looking for innovative thinkers and forward-thinking trailblazers to join our team at LANDED.

**A bit about us**

LANDED is the first end-to-end AI-powered platform for businesses to hire blue collar workers better and faster. With over 1.6 million blue collar workers on LANDED, we are the preferred solution for national brands including Red Robin, Taco Bell, McDonald’s, Five Guys, Tao Hospitality Group, Danny Meyer’s Union Square Hospitality Group, and more. LANDED makes Hiring Managers happy, saving companies time and money by automating candidate sourcing, engagement, and interview scheduling. Our intelligent matching and Generative AI technology connects candidates to employers – helping hire better candidates faster.

LANDED has raised $11M+ to-date, and is backed by top Silicon Valley investors like Javelin Venture Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Blockchain Capital, the founders of Warby Parker, Allbirds, Harry’s, Deel, and Jose Andres Group.

We're looking to hire a Product Manager to supercharge LANDED's next phase of growth.

**About the role**

As a Product Manager, you will play a direct role in shaping the strategic direction of our product, with a deep focus on Generative AI, Systems, and UI/UX. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Operations. This role will touch unique AI applications, technical solutions architecture, integration strategies, and implementation of our SaaS product.

\
**Who you are**

You thrive on innovation and building what’s next. You’ve seen how successful companies operate, but also have scrappiness in your DNA. The successful candidate will be highly motivated with a high degree of focus on detail, process and creativity.\
\
**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Product & Project Management:**
  * Take ownership of the product lifecycle from conception to launch including ideation, coordination, stakeholder management, and measurement of product performance
  * Continually refine workflows, methodologies, and deployment processes to amplify efficiency and quality
  * Define, measure, and share the important critical metrics to measure the success
* **Enterprise-Level Implementations:**
  * Manage and lead end-to-end enterprise implementations, ensuring system integrations are seamless, scalable, and align with client requirements
  * Work with clients to understand their business needs and provide technical guidance on SaaS solution configurations and integrations
  * Define and document integration requirements, working with both internal teams and external clients to design custom solutions as needed
* **System Integrations & Technical Architecture:**
  * Lead the integration of our SaaS platform with client systems, including Applicant Tracking Systems, HRIS, calendar, job board, and other enterprise applications
  * Design, develop, and implement integration strategies that ensure data flow and system interoperability between platforms
  * Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to integrations, ensuring minimal disruption to client operations
* **Customer Discovery:**
  * Engage in customer discovery, ensuring an accurate understanding of customer needs, challenges and expectations
  * Manage customer relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for all technical queries
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  * Serve as the technical liaison between clients and internal teams, translating business needs into technical requirements and solutions
  * Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to drive product improvements based on client feedback and implementation challenges
  * Assist Sales and Customer Success teams with pre-sales activities and post-sales support, providing technical expertise and ensuring customer satisfaction
* **Product Ideation & Market Opportunity:**
  * Deeply analyze customers and business problems to identify the pain points and rapidly create impactful and elegant solutions to specific problems
  * Capture and leverage customer feedback and implementation experiences to influence the product roadmap\
    Be part of the journey to redefine the lives of blue collar workers

**Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of experience in product management or consulting
* 1+ years of experience successfully working with technical teams
* Proficiency in integration technologies such as APIs, JSON, XML, and middleware solutions
* Excellent project management skills, with the ability to handle multiple complex projects simultaneously
* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to think critically and creatively to resolve technical challenges
* Strong understanding of B2B SaaS platforms, cloud technologies, and enterprise software integrations (e.g., ATS, HRIS, databases)
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent client and stakeholder management skills
* Familiarity with enterprise IT environments, security protocols, and compliance standards is a plus

**We'd especially love to speak with you if:**

* You have extensive cross-functional technical integrations and systems experience in the B2B SaaS space; bonus points for experience in a hyper-growth startup or HR Tech industry
* You have worked at a very fast-growing startup
* You have successfully worked in a remote and distributed team environment

By mid next year, we'd like to become India's 3rd largest matrimony player and make our path to No.1. There’s never been a more exciting time to be at Betterhalf.

Company funding:
Betterhalf.ai has successfully raised a $5M Pre-Series A round and is backed by Y Combinator, Tribe Capital, Quiet Capital, Kunal Shah and Nobroker founders. Betterhalf is expected to do Series A in 6 months.

Overview of your role
We are looking for a Growth leader to own and accelerate our efforts around building the best-in-class Growth engine to acquire, engage and retain users on the Betterhalf platform. The objective is to build the overall strategy, set up processes to manage the CAC and lifecycle of the customer and help unlock the multiple growth teams across Acquisition, Activation, Engagement, Data & Analytics, and Growth R&D.

The role involves working closely with cross-functional teams and driving overall performance of the teams by applying growth principles - including experimentation, data-driven optimisation, and customer-centric product experiences.

Who are we looking for?

Someone who has an insatiable desire to increase the user base by experimenting with various common and uncommon hacks. Someone who is always focused on growth, growth and growth. In addition to being extremely curious and eager to learn, if you are also obsessed with metrics and scalability, you are highly analytical and believe in problem solving using technology first - you are exactly who we’re looking for. Speaking in terms of experience, we are looking for someone with experience in scaling a customer product to 10x growth.

Your growth:

You’ll experience Series A, B in 24-months and become integrated as an AVP - Growth in 12-months
You’ll see a 100-people team becoming a 200-people and will grab the rarest opportunity to be in the room where the company’s decisions are planned with founders and business leaders.

Responsibilities and Functions:

You will be responsible for driving product-led growth.
You will own the roadmap, strategy and product growth features/ experiments to drive 10X growth. In order to do this, you will have to continuously measure your KPIs and improvise based on strategic data-driven decisions.
While taking strategic data-driven decisions you will be doing a lot of AB testing experiments based on qualitative user research and consumer psyche.
You should have a thorough understanding of the customer psyche and detailed insights about why customers use our product. (e.g., Why do they use the product? What are their problems? What are their inhibitions to join our platform?)
You will be figuring out efficient low cost acquisition channels and experimenting around them.
You should have good knowledge about referral marketing and being able to create viral growth.
You should follow the best practices for engaging customers, and retaining them for the long term.

What are we looking for?

Min. 3-5 years of experience in user growth for a high-growth consumer app startup
Shipped product features on mobile app or web app, managed sprint cycle and delivered key product growth metrics
Ability to turn complex data and insights into easily understood data stories
Having a growth mindset and someone who is comfortable in a cross-functional environment and ready to work on challenging problems and deal with ambiguity
Proficiency with data and attribution tools, deep analytics, performance monitoring and product research methodologies
Experienced in driving growth through experimentation and analysis
Self-driven with a high degree of ownership and have strong business acumen, excellent communication skills, and planning/project management skills
Ability to operate under tight deadlines while maintaining multiple projects.
Relevant experience in content marketing, SEO and ASO for driving traffic on the web/app product
Previous experience with product management is a bonus.

Preferred Experience:
4-6 years of product-driven growth in B2C company.
5-10L monthly app/ web signups / users with no ads

*Please do not apply if you think ads are required for growth

Compensation:

Fixed CTC: INR 25-35L
Stocks: INR 50L-1 Crore
Additional perks and incentives

If you are looking to build and contribute to the mission of building the next generation matrimony super app for urban Indians, please reach out. We're super thrilled to partner and make you succeed.

*Please do not apply if you think ads are required for growth
interview_process:
Fairly straightforward. HR Person will have a quick 10-15 min chat with the candidate and once aligned, directly the founders get involved. 

1st call: HR Person
2nd call: Product Manager / Marketplace Manager
3rd call: Founder 1 / CEO
4th call: Founder 2 / CTO
5th call: SEO Head

Expect 3-5 round with the company leaders across the product, marketing and marketplace and then offer gets released. While we say 7 days from the first call with the company, in most cases, hiring gets closed in 3-5 days.

If you really think you can drive product growth without ads and demonstrated over 10L monthly web visits / 10L app installs, you can write directly to founders@betterhalf.ai

title: Product Manager
description:
The Product Manager role will contribute across the following areas:

* Manage product development roadmap:


* Collect customer requirements and analyze competitive landscape to generate ideas for the product roadmap
* Create business cases for roadmap initiatives
* Build wireframes in Figma for new products to be implemented
* Analyze new proposed product features / wireframes from the user perspective to perfect feature design and implementation for clients
* Outline functional requirements for new features through creation of detailed user stories
* Help guide implementation of product roadmap for features chosen for development and manage scrum process (utilizing Trello and other scrum tools) to drive forward implementation
* Carry out User Acceptance Testing (UAT) once features have been implemented to confirm they have been fully implemented from the user perspective and provide detailed feedback on unmet requirements


* Create and execute product and analytical solutions to address Redbird customer needs:


* Collaborate with customers to understand their objectives
* Design solutions to meet customer objectives
* Build analytical workflows using the Redbird platform, including:


* Collect data from a variety of data sources
* Clean data and perform Extraction, Transformation, and Loading (ETL) of data
* Run analysis and statistical modeling to interpret the data
* Generate analytical reports
* Set up conversational AI chat environments for users to ask questions on top of their organization’s data ecosystem and Redbird data workflows


* Train and onboard customers and make recommendations on how to best use the Redbird platform


* Develop strategy / marketing / pitch materials and documentation for Redbird products:


* Create product documentation and training guides to help guide and support Redbird platform users
* Generate materials describing new features, pro tips / tricks, and different use cases for the Redbird platform
* Develop strategy decks, capabilities presentations, and sales materials for the company based on knowledge of products / solutions

An ideal candidate would have the following profile:

* Strong interest in technology and AI / data analytics
* Appetite for working in a fast-paced, growing, early-stage startup environment
* Desire to be part of building innovative solutions and software from the ground up
* Ability to take on significant responsibility starting day one and be exposed to multiple aspects of the business
* Exceptional creativity and talent for solving problems through innovation
* General comfort working with data
* Ability to interpret analytical outputs
* Hunger for continually expanding skills and staying current with the latest AI technology

title: Accounting – AI Solutions Lead, US
description:
Hiring accountants to help us scale Combinely across leading US accounting firms.

This is not a traditional accounting role. We’re looking for an ambitious accountant who wants to move fast, work directly with customers, and help shape the future of how accounting work gets done.

### About Combinely

Combinely is building an AI coworker for accountants.

Accounting firms are under huge pressure: shrinking talent pools, rising client expectations, and too much repetitive work across emails, documents, spreadsheets, tax research, and review.

Combinely bridges the gap with Coco – an AI coworker that works inside accounting firms’ existing workflows to produce client-ready work, automate repetitive tasks, and help teams deliver higher quality work faster.

Built by an ex-Google/Deloitte team, we’re growing fast, backed by top investors, and already live inside leading accounting firms across the world.

## What you’ll do

**Deliver magic** – work directly with accounting firms to understand their workflows, build AI agents, and help customers get real value from Coco.

**Talk to customers** – shadow accountants, identify painful manual processes, and translate them into repeatable AI workflows.

**Build the playbook** – help define how Combinely onboards firms, trains users, designs agents, and delivers exceptional customer service.

## You’ll be a fit if you are:

**Accounting-native:** you understand how accounting firms actually work, from client emails and document collection to tax, CAS, review, advisory, or audit.

**Customer-obsessed:** you love solving real customer problems and measure success by whether teams save time and get better work done.

**High agency:** you default to action, figure things out quickly, and leave customers, workflows, and processes better than you found them.

**AI-curious:** you’re excited by what AI can do for accountants and want to help shape how it gets adopted in practice.

## Your experience

### Requirements

* 2+ years experience in an accounting firm, ideally in tax, CAS, audit, advisory, or client-facing work.
* Strong understanding of accounting firm workflows and the day-to-day work accountants do.
* Comfortable working directly with customers and building trusted relationships.
* Excited to learn AI tools and turn messy workflows into clear instructions, agents, and processes.
* Happy to work in-person with customers and travel where needed.
* Authorized to work in the US.

### Nice to haves

* CPA, EA, or similar qualification.
* Experience implementing software, improving internal processes, or training teams.
* Familiarity with tools like CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, Drake, ProConnect, QuickBooks, Xero, Karbon, Canopy, or TaxDome.

## Interview process

We aim to move fast – you can expect an offer within 2 weeks from the first call.

**Founder call, 30 mins** – get to know each other, the role and make sure we’re on the same page.

**Practical task (take-home)** – a realistic workflow design task you might take on at Combinely.

**On-site interview, 2h** – meet the team, deep-dive on your task and walk through past experience.

## Why join now

**Impact** – help define how AI gets adopted across accounting firms and reshape an entire industry.

**Mentorship + autonomy** – work shoulder-to-shoulder with the founders, not through layers of management.

**Own meaningful equity** – enough to not need another job if we succeed.

We look forward to seeing your application!
